a: Kol shebba bechammin millifne hashshabbat — shorin oto bechammin beshabbat, vechol shello ba bechammin millifne hashshabbat — medichin oto bechammin bashshabbat. chutz min hammaliach yashan vekolyays haispanin, shehaddachatan zo hi gemar melachtan. shema minna.

Velo yafkienna besudarin: veha ditnan notnin tavshil letoch habbor bishvil sheyyehe shamur, veet hammayim hayyafim baraim bishvil sheyyitztzannu, veet hatztzonen bachamma bishvil sheyyechammu — lema rabbi yose hi vela rabbanan?

Amar rav nachman: bechamma — dechulle alma la peligi dishre. betoldot haur — kulle alma la peligi daasir. ki peligi betoldot hachamma: mar savar gazrinan toldot hachamma attu toldot haur, umar savar la gazrinan.
Velo yatminenna bechol: veliflog name rabbi yose beha! rabba amar: gezera shemma yatmin beremetz. rav yosef amar: mippene shemmeziz afar mimmekomo. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu afar tichuach.

Metivi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: megalgelin betza al gabbe gag roteach, veen megalgelin betza al gabbe sid roteach. bishlama leman deamar gezera shemma yatmin beremetz — lekka lemigzar. ella leman deamar mippene shemmeziz afar mimmekomo, ligzar? — setam gag let beh afar.

Ta shema: maase sheasu anshe teverya veheviu silon shel tzonen letoch amma shel chammin vechulei. bishlama leman deamar gezera shemma yatmin beremetz — hayeynu dedamya lehatemana. ella leman deamar mippene shemmeziz afar mimmekomo — may ikka lememar?

Mi savrat maase teverya assefa kae? aresha kae: lo yafkienna besudarin verabbi yose mattir, vehachi kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi yose: ha maase deanshe teverya detoldot chamma hu, veasri lehu rabbanan! amar lehu: hahu toldot ur hu, dechalfi appitcha degehinnam.
Amar rav chisda:
b: Mimmaase sheasu anshe teverya veasri lehu rabbanan batla hatemana bedavar hammosif hevel, vaafillu mibbeod yom. amar ulla: halacha keanshe teverya. amar leh rav nachman: kevar tavrinhu anshe teverya lesilonayyhu.

Maase sheasu anshe teverya: may rechitza? illema rechitzat kol gufo — ella chammin shehuchammu beshabbat hu daasurin, ha chammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat muttarin? vehatanya: chammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat, lemachar rochetz bahen panav yadav veraglav, aval lo kol gufo! ella panav yadav veraglav.

Ema sefa: beyom tov, kechammin shehuchammu beyom tov, vaasurin birchitza umuttarin bishtiyya. lema tenan setama kevet shammay? ditnan, bet shammay omrim: lo yachem adam chammin leraglav ella im ken reuyin lishtiyya, uvet hillel mattirin.

Amar rav ika bar chananya: lehishtattef bahen kol gufo askinan, vehay tanna hu detanya: lo yishtattef adam kol gufo ben bechammin uven betzonen — divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon mattir. rabbi yehuda omer: bechammin — asur, betzonen — muttar.

Amar rav chisda: machaloket bichli, aval bekarka — divre hakkol muttar. veha maase deanshe teverya bekarka hava veasri lehu rabbanan! ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: machaloket bekarka, aval bichli — divre hakkol asur.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar leh rav yosef: beferush shemia lach, o mikkelala shemia lach? may kelala? — deamar rav tanchum amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi yannay amar (rav) [rabbi]: kol makom sheatta motze shenayim chalukin veechad machria — halacha kedivre hammachria. chutz mikkulle matlaniyyot, sheaf al pi sherabbi eliezer machmir, verabbi yehoshua mekel, verabbi akiva machria — en halacha kedivre hammachria. chada: derabbi akiva talmid hu. veod: ha

a: Hadar beh rabbi akiva legabbeh derabbi yehoshua. vei mikkelala, may? dilma hane mille bematnitin, aval bevarayyta — la. amar leh: ana beferush shemia li.

Ittemar: chammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat, rav amar: lemachar rochetz bahen kol gufo, ever ever. ushemuel amar: lo hittiru lirchotz ella panav yadav veraglav. metivi: chammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat, lemachar rochetz bahen panav yadav veraglav aval lo kol gufo. teyuveta derav. amar lecha rav: "lo kol gufo" — bevat achat, ella ever ever. veha "panav yadav veraglav" katane! — keen panav yadav veraglav.
Ta shema: lo hittiru lirchotz bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat ella panav yadav veraglav! hacha name, keen panav yadav veraglav.

Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: chammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat, lemachar rochetz bahen panav yadav veraglav, aval lo kol gufo ever ever. veen tzarich lomar chammin shehuchammu beyom tov. rabba matne la leha shemata derav behay lishshana: chammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat lemachar, amar rav: rochetz bahen kol gufo umeshayyer ever echad. etiveh kol hane teyuvata. teyuveta.
Amar leh rav yosef leabbaye: rabba mi ka aved kishmateh derav? amar leh: la yadana. may tibbee leh? peshita dela aved, deha ittotav. (dilma) la shemia leh.

Vei la shemia leh — vadday aved. deamar abbaye: kol mille demar aved kerav, bar mehane telat deaved kishmuel. metilin mibbeged leveged, umadlikin minner lener, vahalacha kerabbi shimon bigrira! — kechumere derav aved, kekulle derav la aved.
Tanu rabbanan: merchatz sheppakku nekavav meerev shabbat, lemotzae shabbat rochetz bo miyyad. pakku nekavav meerev yom tov, lemachar nichnas umazzia, veyotze umishtattef babbayit hachitzon.

Amar rav yehuda: maase bammerchatz shel bene berak sheppakku nekavav meerev yom tov, lemachar nichnas rabbi elazar ben azarya verabbi akiva vehizziu bo veyatzu venishtattefu babbayit hachitzon. ella shechammin shello mechuppin binsarim. keshebba haddavar lifne chachamim, amru: af al pi sheen chammin shello mechuppin binsarin. umishsherabbu ovre avera hitchilu leesor. ambatyaot shel kerakkin — metayyel bahen veeno choshesh.

May "ovre avera"? deamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: battechilla hayu rochatzin bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat. hitchilu habballanim lehachem beshabbat, veomrim: meerev shabbat huchammu. asru et hachammin vehittiru et hazzea. vaadayin hayu rochatzin bechammin veomrim: "meziin anachnu". asru lahen et hazzea vehittiru chamme teverya. vaadayin hayu rochatzin bechamme haur, veomrim: bechamme teverya rachatznu. asru lahen chamme teverya vehittiru lahen et hatztzonen. rau sheen haddavar omed lahen, hittiru lahen chamme teverya vezea bimkomah omedet.
Amar rava: hay man deavar adderabbanan, shere lemikre leh "avaryayna": keman —
b: Ki hay tanna:
Ambatyaot shel kerakkim metayyel bahen veeno choshesh. amar rava: davka kerakkin, aval dichfarim — la. may tama — kevan dezuterin nefish havelayyhu.

Tanu rabbanan: mitchammem adam keneged hammedura veyotze umishtattef betzonen, uvilvad shello yishtattef betzonen veyitchammem keneged hammedura, mippene shemmafshir mayim shealav. tanu rabbanan: mechem adam alunetit umannichah al bene meayim beshabbat, uvilvad shello yavi komkumos shel mayim chammin veyannichennu al bene meayim beshabbat. vedavar ze afillu bachol asur, mippene hassakkana.

Tanu rabbanan: mevi adam kiton mayim umannicho keneged hammedura. lo bishvil sheyyechammu, ella bishvil shettafug tzinnatan. rabbi yehuda omer: mevia ishsha pach shel shemen umenichato keneged hammedura. lo bishvil sheyyivshal, ella bishvil sheyyifshar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ishsha sacha yadah shemen umechammamtah keneged hammedura, vesacha livnah katan, veenah chosheshet.

Ibbaya lehu: shemen ma hu letanna kamma? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu lehettera, rav nachman bar yitzchak amar leissura. rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu lehettera: shemen af al pi shehayyad soledet bo — muttar. kasavar tanna kamma shemen en bo mishshum bishshul. vaata rabbi yehuda lememar shemen yesh bo mishshum bishshul, vehefshero lo ze hu bishshulo. vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar shemen yesh bo mishshum bishshul, vehefshero zehu bishshulo.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar leissura: shemen af al pi sheen hayyad soledet bo — asur. kasavar shemen yesh bo mishshum bishshul, vehefshero zehu bishshulo. vaata rabbi yehuda lememar hefshero lo zehu bishshulo. vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar shemen yesh bo mishshum bishshul, vehefshero zehu bishshulo. rabban shimon ben gamliel hayeynu tanna kamma? ikka benayyhu kilachar yad.
Amar rabbi yehuda amar shemuel: echad shemen veechad mayim, yad soledet bo — asur, en yad soledet bo — muttar. vehechi dame yad soledet bo? amar rachava: kol shekkereso shel tinok nichvet.

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: paam achat nichnasti achar rabbi levet hammerchatz, uvikkashti lehanniach lo pach shel shemen beambati, veamar li: tol bichli sheni veten. shema minna telat: shema minna shemen yesh bo mishshum bishshul, ushema minna keli sheni eno mevashshel, ushema minna hefshero zehu bishshulo.

Hechi aved hachi, vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bechol makom muttar lehareher chutz mibbet hammerchatz uvet hakkisse! vechi tema bilshon chol amar leh, vehaamar abbaye: devarim shel chol muttar leomran bilshon kodesh, shel kodesh asur leomran bilshon chol! afroshe meissura shane.

Tidda, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: maase betalmido shel rabbi meir shennichnas acharav levet hammerchatz uvikkesh lehaddiach karka. veamar lo: en maddichin. lasuch lo karka. amar lo: en sachin. alma afroshe meissura shane, hacha name leafroshe meissura shane.

Amar ravina: shema minna hamevashshel bechamme teverya beshabbat — chayyayv. deha maase derabbi leachar gezera hava, vaamar leh: tol bichli sheni veten. ini?! vehaamar rav chisda hamevashshel bechamme teverya beshabbat — patur! may "chayyayv" name dekaamar — makkat mardut.
Amar rabbi zera: ana chaziteh lerabbi avahu deshat beambati, vela yadana i akar i la akar. peshita dela akar, detanya: lo yashut adam bivrecha melea mayim, vaafillu omedet bechatzer! la kashya, ha

a: Delet leh giddude, ha deit leh giddude.

Veamar rabbi zera: ana chaziteh lerabbi avahu shehinniach yadav keneged panav shel matta, vela yadana i nega i la nega. peshita dela nega, detanya rabbi eliezer omer: kol haochez baamma umashtin — keillu mevi mabbul laolam.

Amar abbaye: asauha kevoleshet. ditnan: boleshet shennichnesa lair, bishat shalom — chaviyyot petuchot asurot, setumot muttarot. bishat milchama — ellu veellu muttarot, lefi sheen penay lenassech. alma kevan diviti la menassechi. hacha name, kevan divit la ate leharehore. hacha may biatuta? biatuta denahra.

Ini?! vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: kol hammanniach yadav keneged panav shel matta keillu kofer bivrito shel avraham avinu! la kashya: ha ki nachet, ha ki salek. ki ha derava shache. rabbi zera zakef. rabbanan deve rav ashe, ki ka nachati — zakfi, ki ka salki — shachu.

Rabbi zera hava ka mishtemit midderav yehuda, devae lemissak leara deyisrael. deamar rav yehuda: kol haole mibbavel leeretz yisrael over baase, shenneemar: "bavela yuvau veshamma yihyu". amar: ezil veeshma minneh milleta veete veessak. azal, ashkecheh dekae be vane vekaamar leh leshammaeh: haviu li neter, haviu li masrek, pitchu pummayychu veappiku havela, veishtu mimmayya deve vane. amar: ilmale lo bati ella lishmoa davar ze dayyi.

Bishlama "haviu neter, haviu masrek" — kamashma lan devarim shel chol muttar leomram bilshon kodesh. "pitchu pummayychu veappiku havela" — name kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: havela mappek havela. ella "ishtu mayya deve vane" may mealleyuta? detanya achal velo shata — achilato dam, vezehu techillat choli meayim. achal velo halach arba ammot — achilato markevet, vezehu techillat reach ra. hannitzrach linkavav veachal — dome letannur shehissikuhu al gabbe efro, vezehu techillat reach zuhama. rachatz bechammin velo shata mehen — dome letannur shehissikuhu mibbechutz velo hissikuhu mibbifnim. rachatz bechammin velo nishtattef betzonen — dome levarzel shehichnisuhu laur velo hichnisuhu letzonen. rachatz velo sach — dome lemayim al gabbe chavit.
Mishna muleyar haggaruf shotin hemennu beshabbat. antiche, af al pi sheggerufa en shotin hemenna.

Gemara hechi dame muleyar haggaruf? tana, mayim mibbifnim vegechalim mibbechutz. antiche: rabba amar — be chire. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar — be dude. man deamar be dude kol shekken be chire, uman deamar be chire aval be dude — la. tanya kevoteh derav nachman: antiche af al pi sheggerufa uketuma en shotin hemenna mippene shennechushetah mechammamtah.
Mishna hammecham sheppinnahu lo yitten letocho tzonen bishvil sheyyechammu. aval noten hu letocho o letoch hakkos kede lehafeshiran.

Gemara may kaamar? amar rav adda bar matna, hachi kaamar: hammecham sheppinna mimmennu mayim chammin lo yitten letochan mayim muatim kede sheyyechammu, aval noten letocho mayim merubbim kede lehafeshiran.
b: Vahalo metzaref? rabbi shimon hi, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven — muttar. matkif la abbaye: midde mecham sheppinna mimmennu mayim katane?! mecham sheppinnahu katane!

Ella amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: hammecham sheppinnahu veyesh bo mayim chammin — lo yitten letocho mayim muatin bishvil sheyyachommu, aval noten letocho mayim merubbim kede lehafeshiran. umecham sheppinna mimmennu mayim — lo yitten letocho mayim kol ikkar, mippene shemmetzaref. verabbi yehuda hi, deamar davar sheen mitkavven asur.

Amar rav: lo shanu ella lehafeshir, aval letzaref — asur. ushemuel amar: afillu letzaref name muttar. letzaref lechattechilla mi shere?! ella i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav lo shanu ella shiur lehafeshir, aval shiur letzaref — asur. ushemuel amar: afillu shiur letzaref —

a: Muttar.

Lememra dishmuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh? vehaamar shemuel: mechabbin gachelet shel mattechet birshut harabbim bishvil shello yizzoku bah rabbim, aval lo gachelet shel etz. vei salka datach savar la kerabbi shimon — afillu shel etz name!

Bedavar sheen mitkavven savar la kerabbi shimon, bimlacha sheenah tzericha legufah savar la kerabbi yehuda. amar ravina: hilkach kotz birshut harabbim molicho pachot pachot mearba ammot, uvecharmelit afillu tuva.

Aval noten kulei. tanu rabbanan: noten adam chammin letoch hatztzonen, velo hatztzonen letoch hachammin, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: ben chammin letoch hatztzonen uven tzonen letoch hachammin muttar. bamme devarim amurim — bechos, aval beambati — chammin letoch hatztzonen, velo tzonen letoch hachammin. verabbi shimon ben menasya oser. amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi shimon ben menasya.

Savar rav yosef lememar sefel hare hu keambati. amar leh abbaye, tane rabbi chiyyay: sefel eno keambati. ulemay dislek addata meikkara desefel hare hu keambati, veamar rav nachman halacha kerabbi shimon ben menasya, ella beshabbat rechitza bechammin lekka!

Mi savrat rabbi shimon assefa kae? aresha kae: uvet hillel mattirin ben chammin letoch tzonen uven tzonen letoch hachammin, verabbi shimon ben menasya oser tzonen letoch chammin. lema rabbi shimon ben menasya deamar kevet shammay? — hachi kaamar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze.

Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: chazena leh lerava dela kafed ammana — middetane rabbi chiyyay: noten adam kiton shel mayim letoch sefel shel mayim, ben chammin letoch tzonen uven tzonen letoch chammin. amar leh rav huna lerav ashe: dilma shane hatam demafsek keli! amar leh — "meare" ittemar: meare adam kiton shel mayim letoch sefel shel mayim, ben chammin letoch tzonen, ben tzonen letoch chammin.
Mishna hailpas vehakkedera sheheeviran meruttachin — lo yitten letochan tavlin.
b: Aval noten hu letoch hakkeara o letoch hattamchuy. rabbi yehuda omer: lakkol hu noten, chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vatzir.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: rabbi yehuda aresha kae — ulekulla, o dilma assefa kae — ulechumera.
Ta shema, detanya rabbi yehuda omer: lechol ilpasin hu noten, lechol hakkederot rotchot hu noten, chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vatzir.

Savar rav yosef lememar melach hare hu ketavlin, devichli rishon — bashla, uvichli sheni — la bashla. amar leh abbaye: tane rabbi chiyyay, melach enah ketavlin, devichli sheni name bashla! ufeliga derav nachman, deamar rav nachman: tzericha milcha bishshula kevisra detora.

Veikka deamri: savar rav yosef lememar melach hare hu ketavlin, devichli rishon — bashla, bichli sheni — la bashla. amar leh abbaye: tane rabbi chiyyay melach enah ketavlin, devichli rishon name la bashla, vehayeynu deamar rav nachman: tzericha milcha bishshula kevisra detora.
Mishna en notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel bo et hashshemen. veim netanuha mibbeod yom — muttar, veen neotin mimmennu lefi sheeno min hammuchan.

Gemara amar rav chisda: af al pi sheamru en notnin keli tachat tarnegolet lekabbel betzatah, aval kofe aleha keli shello tishshaver. amar rabba: may tama derav chisda? kasavar, tarnegolet asuya lehattil betzatah baashpa, veenah asuya lehattil betzatah bimkom midron. vehatztzala metzuya hittiru, vehatztzala sheenah metzuya — lo hittiru.
Etiveh abbaye: vehatztzala sheenah metzuya lo hittiru?! vehatanya: nishbera lo chavit shel tevel berosh gaggo, mevi keli umanniach tachteha! — begulefe chadte dishchichi defaki.
Etiveh: notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot? — nitzotzot name shechichi.

a: Etiveh: kofin keara al hanner shello yeachez bakkora? — bevatte gechini dishchiach behu deleka.
Vechen kora shennishbera, somchin otah bassafsal uvaarukkot hammitta! — bichshure chadte daavidi defaki.
Notnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat! — bevatte chadti dishchichi dedalfi.
Rav yosef amar, hayeynu tama derav chisda: mishshum deka mevattel keli mehechano.
Etiveh abbaye: chavit shel tevel shennishbera — mevi keli acher umanniach tachteha! amar leh: tevel muchan hu etzel shabbat, sheim avar vetikkeno — metukkan.
Notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot! amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: nitzotzot en bahen mammash.
Vechen kora shennishbera, somchin otah bassafsal o baarukkot hammitta! — derafi, dei bae shakel leh.
Notnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat! — bedelef harauy.

Kofin et hassal lifne haefrochin sheyyaalu veyerdu! kasavar muttar letaltelo. vehatanya, asur letaltelo? beodan alav. vehatanya, af al pi sheen odan alav — asur! amar rabbi avahu: beodan alav kol ben hashshemashot. miggo deitketzay leven hashshemashot — itketzay lechulle yoma.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: keshem sheen notnin keli tachat tarnegolet lekabbel betzatah — kach en kofin aleha keli bishvil shello tishshaver. kasavar: en keli nittal ella ledavar hannittal beshabbat. etiveh kol hane teyuvata, veshanni: betzarich limkomo.

Ta shema: achat betza shennolda beshabbat, veachat betza shennolda beyom tov en metaltelin otah lechassot bah et hakkeli velismoch bah kare hammitta, aval kofe aleha keli bishvil shello tishshaver! — hacha name betzarich limkomo.
Ta shema: porsin machtzalot al gabbe avanim beshabbat! — baavanim mekurezalot dechazyayn levet hakkisse.
Ta shema: porsin machtzalot al gabbe levenim beshabbat! — deishtayyur mibbinyana, dechazyayn lemizga alayyhu.

Ta shema: porsin machtzelet al gabbe kavvevret devorim beshabbat, bachamma — mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim — mippene haggeshamim. uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud! hacha vemay askinan — deikka devash. amar leh rav ukeva mimmishan lerav ashe: tinach bimot hachamma
b: Deikka devash. bimot haggeshamim delekka devash, may ikka lememar? lo nitzrecha ella leotan shete challot. veha muketzot ninhu! — dechashshev alayyhu. ha la chashshev alayyhu may — asur?

I hachi, ha detane: "uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud" — liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — keshechishshev alehen, aval lo chishshev alehen — asur! ha kamashma lan: af al pi shechishshev alehen, uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud.

Manni? i rabbi shimon — let leh muketze. i rabbi yehuda — ki lo mitkavven may have? ha davar sheen mitkavven — asur! leolam rabbi yehuda. may "uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud" — shello yaasenna kimtzuda, delishbok lehu ravvcha ki hechi dela littatzdu mimmela.

Rav ashe amar: mi katane "bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim"? "bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim" katane, beyome nisan uveyome tishre, deikka chamma veikka tzinna veikka geshamim veikka devash.
Amar lehu rav sheshet: puku veemaru leh lerabbi yitzchak: kevar targema rav huna lishmataych bevavel. deamar rav huna: osin mechitza lemet bishvil chay, veen osin mechitza lemet bishvil met.

May hi? — deamar rav shemuel bar yehuda, vechen tana shela mari: met hammuttal bachamma, baim shene bene adam veyoshvin betziddo. cham lahem millematta, ze mevi mitta veyoshev aleha veze mevi mitta veyoshev aleha. cham lahem millemala, meviim machtzelet uforsin alehen. ze zokef mittato venishmat veholech lo, veze zokef mittato venishmat veholech lo, venimtzet mechitza asuya meeleha.

Ittemar, met hammuttal bachamma. rav yehuda amar shemuel: hofcho mimmitta lemitta. rav chanina bar shelemya mishshemeh derav amar: manniach alav kikkar o tinok umetaltelo. hecha deikka kikkar o tinok kulle alma la peligi dishre. ki peligi delet leh: mar savar tiltul min hatztzad shemeh tiltul, umar savar la shemeh tiltul.

Lema chetannae: en matztzilin et hammet mippene haddeleka. amar rabbi yehuda ben lakish: shamati shemmatztzilin et hammet mippene haddeleka. hechi dame: i deikka kikkar o tinok, may tama detanna kamma? i delekka, may tama derabbi yehuda ben lakish? ella lav betiltul min hatztzad peligi. demar savar tiltul min hatztzad shemeh tiltul, umar savar la shemeh tiltul! la, dechulle alma tiltul min hatztzad shemeh tiltul, vehayeynu tama derabbi yehuda ben lakish: demittoch sheadam bahul al meto

a: I la sharet leh, ate lechabboye. amar rabbi yehuda ben shela amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben lakish bemet.
En neotin hemennu, lefi sheeno min hammuchan. tanu rabbanan: motar hashshemen shebbanner veshebbakkeara asur. verabbi shimon mattir.
Mishna metaltelin ner chadash aval lo yashan. rabbi shimon omer: kol hannerot mittaltelin, chutz min hanner haddolek beshabbat.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: metaltelin ner chadash aval lo yashan, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: kol hannerot mittaltelin, chutz min hanner shehidliku bo beshabbat. rabbi shimon omer: chutz min hanner haddolek beshabbat. kavta — muttar letaltelah. aval kos ukeara vaashashit lo yezizem mimkomam. verabbi eliezer berabbi shimon omer: mistappek min hanner hakkave umin hashshemen hametaftef, vaafillu beshaa shehanner dolek.

Amar abbaye: rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon savar la kaavu bachada, ufelig aleh bachada. savar la kaavu bachada — delet leh muketze. ufelig aleh bachada — deillu avu savar kava — in, lo kava — la, veihu savar af al gav delo kava.
Aval kos ukeara vaashashit lo yezizem mimkomam. may shena hane? amar ulla: sefa atan lerabbi yehuda.
Matkif la mar zutera: i hachi, may "aval"? ella amar mar zutera: leolam rabbi shimon. vechi kashare rabbi shimon — bener zuta dedateh illaveh, aval hane dinfishi — la.
Vehatanya: motar hashshemen shebbanner veshebbakkeara — asur, verabbi shimon mattir! hatam keara dumeya dener, hacha keara dumeya dechos.

Amar rabbi zera: pamot shehidliku bo beshabbat, ledivre hammattir — asur. ledivre haoser — muttar. lememra derabbi yehuda — muketze mechamat mius it leh, muketze mechamat issur let leh? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kol hannerot shel mattechet mittaltelin, chutz min hanner shehidliku bo beshabbat! ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rabbi zera: pamot shehidliku alav beshabbat — divre hakkol asur. lo hidliku alav — divre hakkol muttar.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: mitta sheyyichadah lemaot asur letaltelah. metiv rav nachman bar yitzchak: metaltelin ner chadash aval lo yashan!
b: Uma ner dilhachi avida, ki la adlek bah shere letaltola — mitta delav lehachi avida lo chol shekken?! ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rav yehuda amar rav: mitta sheyyichadah lemaot, hinniach aleha maot — asur letaltelah, lo hinniach aleha maot — muttar letaltelah. lo yichadah lemaot, yesh aleha maot — asur letaltelah, en aleha maot — muttar letaltelah. vehu shello hayu aleha ben hashshemashot.
Amar ulla, metiv rabbi eliezer: mucheni shellah bizman shehi nishmetet, en chibbur lah veen nimdedet immah veen matztzelet immah beohel hammet veen gorrin otah beshabbat — bizman sheyyesh aleha maot.
Ha en aleha maot — sharya, af al gav dahavo aleha ben hashshemashot! hahi rabbi shimon hi delet leh muketze, verav kerabbi yehuda sevira leh.

a: Hachi name mistabbera derav kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, deamar rav: mannichin ner al gabbe dekel beshabbat, veen mannichin ner al gabbe dekel beyom tov. i amrat bishlama derav kerabbi yehuda sevira leh — hayeynu deshane ben shabbat leyom tov. ella i amrat kerabbi shimon sevira leh, ma li shabbat uma li yom tov?

Verav kerabbi yehuda sevira leh? veha beo minneh derav mahu letaltole sheraga dachanukketa mikkamme chabbare beshabbeta, vaamar lehu: shappir dame! — sheat haddechak shane. deha amaru lehu rav kahana verav ashe lerav: hachi hilcheta? amar lehu: keday hu rabbi shimon lismoch alav bishat haddechak.

Bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: chittim shezzeraan bekarka, uvetzim shettachat tarnegolet — mahu? ki let leh lerabbi shimon muketze — hecha dela dachyeh beyadayim, hecha dedachyeh beyadayim — it leh muketze, o dilma la shena. amar leh: en muketze lerabbi shimon ella shemen shebbanner beshaa shehu dolek, hoil vehuketza lemitzvato huketza leissuro.

Velet leh huketza lemitzvato? vehatanya: sikkecha kehilchatah veittera bikramim uvisdinin hametzuyyayrin, vetala bah egozin, afarsekin, shekedim verimmonin, ufarkile anavim, vaatarot shel shibbolin, yenot, shemanim uselatot — asur lehistappek mehen ad motzae yom tov haacharon. veim hitna alehen — hakkol lefi tenao.

Umimmay derabbi shimon hi — detane rabbi chiyyay bar yosef kammeh derabbi yochanan: en notlin etzim min hassukka beyom tov ella min hassamuch lah. verabbi shimon mattir. veshavin besukkat hachag bechag shehi asura, veim hitna aleha — hakkol lefi tenao. keen shemen shebbanner kaamrinan, hoil vehuketza lemitzvato huketza leissuro. ittemar name, amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: en muketze lerabbi shimon ella keen shemen shebbanner beshaa shehu dolek, hoil vehuketza lemitzvato huketza leissuro.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en muketze lerabbi shimon ella gerogrot vetzimmukim bilvad. umiddi acharina la? vehatanya: haya ochel bitenim vehotir veheelan laggag laasot mehen gerogrot, baanavim vehotir veheelan laggag laasot mehen tzimmukin — lo yochal ad sheyyazmin. vechen atta omer baafarsekin vachavushin uvishar kol mine perot.
Manni? ilema rabbi yehuda — uma hecha dela dachyeh beyadayim it leh muketze, hecha dedachyeh beyadayim lo kol shekken?

Ella lav rabbi shimon hi! leolam rabbi yehuda, veochel itztericha leh. salka datach amena, kevan dekaachel veazel la live hazemana. kamashma lan, kevan deheelan laggag assoche asseche ledateh minnayyhu.
Bea minneh rabbi shimon bar rabbi merabbi:
b: Patzile temara, lerabbi shimon mahu? amar lo: en muketze lerabbi shimon ella gerogrot vetzimmukin bilvad.

Verabbi let leh muketze? vehatnan en mashkin veshochatin et hammidbariyyot, aval mashkin veshochatin et habbayyaytot. vetanya: ellu hen midbariyyot? — kol sheyyotzot bappesach venichnasot barvia. bayyaytot — kol sheyyotzot veroot chutz lattechum, uvaot velanot betoch hattechum. rabbi omer: ellu veellu bayyaytot hen. veellu hen midbariyyot: kol sheroot baafar, veen nichnasot layyishshuv lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim.
Ibbaet ema: hane name kigrogrot vetzimmukin damyayn. vei baet ema: lidvarav derabbi shimon kaamar leh, veleh la sevira leh.

Veibbaet ema, ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi let li muketze kelal, ledidchu odu li mihat dehecha deyotzot bappesach venichnasot barvia devayyaytot ninhu. verabbanan? — amru leh: la, midbariyyot ninhu.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: amru halacha kerabbi shimon. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha bea minneh hahu sava karoya, veamri la, saroya merabbi yochanan: kinnah shel tarnegolet mahu letaltole beshabbat? amar leh: kelum asuy ella letarnegolin! hacha vemay askinan — deit beh efroach met.

Hanicha lemar bar ammemar mishshemeh (derav) [derava] deamar: mode haya rabbi shimon bevaale chayyim shemmetu sheasurin. ella lemar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava deamar: chaluk haya rabbi shimon [afillu] bevaale chayyim shemmetu shehen muttarin, may ikka lememar? hacha bemay askinan — bidit beh betza.
Vehaamar rav nachman: man deit leh muketze — it leh nolad, delet leh muketze — let leh nolad! deit beh betzat efroach.

Ki ata rav yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: halacha kerabbi shimon. amar rav yosef: hayeynu deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: amru halacha kerabbi shimon. amru, veleh la sevira leh.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: veat la tisbera derabbi yochanan kerabbi yehuda, ha rabbi abba verabbi assi ikkelau leve rabbi abba demin chefa, unefal menarta al gelimeh derabbi assi vela taltela. may tama? lav mishshum derabbi assi talmideh derabbi yochanan hava, verabbi yochanan kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, deit leh muketze!

Amar leh: menarta kaamrat? menarta shane, deamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi assi: hora resh lakish betzaydan: menora hannittelet beyado achat — muttar letaltelah, bishte yadav — asur letaltelah. verabbi yochanan amar: anu en lanu ella bener kerabbi shimon. aval menora, ben nittelet beyado achat ben nittelet bishte yadav — asur letaltelah.

Vetama may? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu: hoil veadam kovea lah makom. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: vahare killat chatanim deadam kovea lo makom, veamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyyay: killat chatanim

a: Muttar lintotah umuttar lefarka beshabbat. ella amar abbaye: beshel chuleyot. i hachi, may tama derabbi shimon ben lakish deshare?

May "chuleyot" — keen chuleyot, deit ba chidke. hilkach: chuleyot, ben gedola ben ketanna — asura letaltelah. gedola name deit bah chidke — gezera attu gedola dechuleyot. ki peligi biktanna deit bah chidke: mar savar gazrinan, umar savar la gazrinan.

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna. utenan, mucheni shellah bizman shehi nishmetet — en chibbur lah, veen nimdedet immah, veen matztzelet immah beohel hammet, veen gorrin otah beshabbat bizman sheyyesh aleha maot.
Ha en aleha maot — sharya, veaf al gav dahavo aleha ben hashshemashot? amar rabbi zera: tehe mishnatenu shello hayu aleha maot kol ben hashshemashot, shello lishbor devarav shel rabbi yochanan.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: paam achat halach rabbi lidyosfara, vehora bimnora kerabbi shimon bener. ibbaya lehu: hora bimnora kerabbi shimon bener — lehettera, o dilma: hora bimnorah leissura — ucherabbi shimon bener lehettera. teku.

Rav malkiyya ikkela leve rabbi simlay vetayltel sheraga, veikkefad rabbi simlay. rabbi yose galilaa ikkela leatreh derabbi yose berabbi chanina, tayltel sheraga veikkefad rabbi yose berabbi chanina. rabbi avahu ki ikkela leatreh derabbi yehoshua ben levi hava metaltel sheraga. ki ikkela leatreh derabbi yochanan la hava metaltel sheraga. ma nafshach? i kerabbi yehuda sevira leh — lebad kerabbi yehuda. i kerabbi shimon sevira leh — lebad kerabbi shimon! — leolam kerabbi shimon sevira leh, umishshum kevodo derabbi yochanan hu dela hava aved.
Amar rav yehuda: sheraga demishcha shere letaltola, denafta — asir letaltola. rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: denafta name shere letaltola, dehoil vachaze lechassot beh mana.

Rav avya ikkela leve rava. hava meisan (be) kareh betina. ittev appureya kammeh derava. ikkefad rava, bea letzaoreh. amar leh: may tama rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu sheraga denafta name shere letaltola? amar leh: hoil vechazya lechassoye ba mana. ella meatta, kol tzerorot shebbechatzer mittaltelin, hoil vechazyin lechassoye behu mana. amar leh: ha ikka torat keli aleha. hane lekka torat keli alehen. mi la tanya:
b: Hashsherim vehannezamim vehattabbaot, hare hen kechol hakkelim hannittalim bechatzer. veamar ulla: ma taam? — hoil veikka torat keli alehen. hacha name hoil veikka torat keli alehen. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: berich rachamana dela kassefeh rava lerav avya.

Rame leh abbaye lerabba. tanya: motar hashshemen shebbanner veshebbakkeara — asur, verabbi shimon mattir. alma lerabbi shimon let leh muketze. ureminhu, rabbi shimon omer: kol sheen mumo nikkar meerev yom tov — en ze min hammuchan!

Hachi hasheta? hatam, adam yoshev umetzappe ematay tichbe nero. hacha, adam yoshev umetzappe matay yippol bo mum? memar amar: mi yemar denafel beh muma, veim timtze lomar denafel beh muma — mi yemar denafel beh mum kavua. veim timtze lomar denafel beh mum kavua — mi yemar demizdekek leh chacham?
Metiv rame bar chama: meferin nedarim beshabbat, [venishalin lindarim shehen] letzorech hashshabbat. veammay? — lema: mi yemar demizdekek la baal?
Hatam kidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava. deamar rav pinchas mishshemeh derava: kol hannoderet — al daat balah hi noderet.

Ta shema: nishalin lindarim shel tzorech hashshabbat beshabbat. veammay? lema: mi yemar demizdekek leh chacham? — hatam — i la mizdekek leh chacham sagya leh bishlosha hedyotot. hacha — mi yemar demizdekek leh chacham.

Rame leh abbaye lerav yosef: mi amar rabbi shimon kavta muttar letaltelah. kavta — in, lo kavta — la. may tama? — dilma bahade denaket la kavya? ha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkavven — muttar. detanya rabbi shimon omer: gorer adam kisse mitta vesafsal, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot charitz!
Kol hecha dechi mikkaven ikka issura deorayyta, ki la mikkaven — gazar rabbi shimon midderabbanan. kol hecha dechi mikkaven ikka issura derabbanan — ki la mikkaven share rabbi shimon lechattechilla.

Metiv rava: mochre chesut mochrin kedarkan, uvilvad shello yitkavven bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim, vehatztzenuin mafshilin bemakkel laachorehen. veha hacha, dechi mikkaven — issura deorayyta ikka, ki la mikkaven — share rabbi shimon lechattechilla!
Ella amar rava:

a: Hannach lener shemen ufetila, hoil denaasa basis laddavar haasur.

Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi chanina amar rabbi romanos: li hittir rabbi letaltel machta beefrah. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: mi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehatnan: notel adam beno vehaeven beyado o kalkalla vehaeven betochah. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bechalkalla melea perot askinan. tama deit ba pere, ha let ba pere — la?
"Eshtomam keshaa chada", vaamar: hacha name deit ba keratin. amar abbaye: keratin be rabbi mi chashivi?
Vechi tema: chazu laaniyyim — vehatanya, bigde aniyyim laaniyyim, bigde ashirim laashirim, aval daaniyyim laashirim la. ella amar abbaye: midde dehave aggeraf shel rei.

Amar rava, shete teshuvot baddavar: chada, geraf shel rei meis, vehay la meis. veod, geraf shel rei miggalle, vehay mikkasse. ella amar rava: ki havenan be rav nachman hava metaltelinan kanuna aggav kitma, veaf al gav deikka aleh shivre etzim. metivi: veshavin sheim yesh bah shivre petila sheasur letaltel! amar abbaye: begalila shanu.

Levi bar shemuel ashkechinhu lerabbi abba ulerav huna bar chiyyay dahavo kayymi appitcha deve rav huna. amar lehu: mahu lehachazir mitta shel tarsiyyim beshabbat? amaru leh: shappir dame. ata lekammeh derav yehuda, amar: ha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: hammachazir mitta shel tarsiyyim beshabbat — chayyayv chattat.

Metivi: hammachazir kene menora beshabbat — chayyayv chattat. kene sayyaydin — lo yachazir, veim hechezir — patur, aval asur. rabbi simay omer: keren agulla — chayyayv. keren peshuta — patur. inhu daamur ki hay tanna detanya: malbenot hammitta vechare hammitta ulevochim shel sekivas — lo yachazir, veim hechezir — patur,
b: Aval asur. velo yitka, veim taka — chayyayv chattat. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im haya rafuy — muttar.

Be rav chama hava mitta gelalnita. hava mehadderi la beyoma tava. amar leh hahu midderabbanan lerava: may dataych — binyan min hatztzad hu? nehi deissura deorayyta lekka, issura derabbanan miha ikka! amar leh: ana kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira li deamar im haya rafuy — muttar.
Mishna notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot, velo yitten letocho mayim mippene shehu mechabbe.
Gemara veha kamvattel keli mehechano! amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: nitzotzot en bahen mammash.
Velo yitten letocho mayim mippene shehu mechabbe: lema tenan setama kerabbi yose, deamar gorem lechibbuy — asur.

Vetisbera? emor deamar rabbi yose — beshabbat, beerev shabbat mi amar? vechi tema hacha name beshabbat, vehatanya: notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot beshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beerev shabbat. velo yitten letocho mayim mippene shehu mechabbe — meerev shabbat, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. ella amar rav ashe: afillu tema rabbanan, shane hacha — mippene shemmekarev et kibbuyo.
Haderan alach kira
Mishna bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin? — en tomnin lo baggefet velo bazzevel, lo bammelach velo bassid velo bachol — ben lachin ben yeveshin.
Velo batteven velo bazzaggin velo bammochin velo baasavin — bizman shehen lachin, aval tomnin bahen keshehen yeveshin.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: gefet shel zetim tenan, aval deshumeshmin shappir dame, o dilma deshumeshmin tenan vechol shekken dezetim?!
Ta shema, deamar rabbi zera mishshum chad deve rabbi yannay: kuppa shettaman bah — asur lehannichah al gefet shel zetim. shema minna shel zetim tenan.
Leolam ema lach leinyan hatemana — deshumeshmin name asur, leinyan

a: Assoke havela — dezetim masseki havela, deshumeshmin la masseki havela.

Rabba verabbi zera ikkelau leve resh galuta. chazyu lehahu avda deannach kuza demayya appumma dekumekuma. nazheh rabba. amar leh rabbi zera: may shena mimmecham al gabbe mecham? amar leh: hatam okome ka mokem, hacha olode ka moled.

Hadar chazyeh difras dastodar appummeh dechubba veannach natla illaveh. nazheh rabba. amar leh rabbi zera: ammay? amar leh: hasheta chazet. lesof chazyeh deka meatztzar leh. amar leh: may shena mipperonka? amar leh: hatam la kafed illaveh, hacha kafed illaveh.
Velo batteven. bea minneh rav adda bar matna meabbaye: mochin shettaman bahen, mahu letaltelan beshabbat?
Amar leh: vechi mippene sheen lo kuppa shel teven, omed umafkir kuppa shel mochin?
Lema mesayyay leh: tomnin begizze tzemer uvetzippe tzemer uvilshonot shel argaman uvemochin, veen metaltelin otan.
I mishshum ha — la irya, hachi kaamar: im lo taman bahen en metaltelin otan.
I hachi may lememra! mahu detema chaze lemizga alayyhu, kamashma lan.

Rav chisda shera leahdore udera leve sadya beshabbeta. etiveh rav chanan bar chisda lerav chisda: mattirin bet hatztzavvar beshabbat, aval lo potchin. veen notnin et hammochin lo letoch hakkar velo letoch hakkeset beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat.
La kashya, ha bechadte ha beattike.
Tanya name hachi: en notnin et hammochin lo letoch hakkar velo letoch hakkeset beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. nashru, machazirin otan beshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beyom tov.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: happoteach bet hatztzavvar beshabbat — chayyayv chattat.
Matkif la rav kahana:
b: Ma ben zo limgufat chavit. amar leh rava: ze chibbur, veze eno chibbur.

Rame leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: tenan: shelal shel kovsin, veshalshelet shel maftechot, vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim chibbur lattumea — ad sheyyatchil lehattir. alma shello bishat melacha name chibbur.
Ureminhu: makkel sheasao yad lekuredom — chibbur lattumea bishat melacha. bishat melacha — in, shello bishat melacha — la!
Amar leh: hatam shello bishat melacha adam asuy lezorko leven haetzim, hacha shello bishat melacha name nicha leh, dei mittannefu hadar mechavvavr lehu.
Besura matnu la leha shemata mishshemeh derav chisda, befumebdita matnu mishshemeh derav kahana, veamri la mishshemeh derava: man tena ha milleta daamur rabbanan kol hamechubbar lo hare hu kamohu?
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: rabbi meir hi. ditnan: bet happach uvet hattavlin uvet hanner shebbakkira metammein bemagga veen metammein baavir, divre rabbi meir. verabbi shimon metaher.
Bishlama lerabbi shimon — kasavar lav kechira damu. ella lerabbi meir, i kechira damu — afillu baavir name littammu. i lav kechira damu — afillu bemagga name la littammu!
Leolam lav kechira damu verabbanan hu digzaru behu. i gezaru behu, afillu baavir name littammu!
Avadu behu rabbanan hekkera ki hechi dela ate lemisraf aleh teruma vekodashim.
Tanu rabbanan: masporet shel perakim veizmel shel rahitne chibbur lattumea, veen chibbur lahazzaa.

Ma nafshach: i chibbur hu — afillu lehazzaa name, i lav chibbur hu — afillu letumea name la! amar rava: devar tora bishat melacha chibbur — ben letumea ben lehazzaa. veshello bishat melacha — eno chibbur lo letumea velo lehazzaa.

a: Vegazru rabbanan al tumea shello bishat melacha mishshum tumea shebbishat melacha, veal hazzaa shebbishat melacha mishshum hazzaa shello bishat melacha.
Bizman shehen lachin. ibbaya lehu: lachin mechamat atzman, o dilma lachin mechamat davar acher.

Ta shema: lo batteven velo bazzaggim velo bammochin velo baasavim bizman shehen lachin. i amrat bishlama lachin mechamat davar acher — shappir. ella i amrat lachin mechamat atzman, mochin lachin mechamat atzman hechi mashkachat la? — mimmirta devene atme.
Veha detane rabbi oshaya: tomnin bichsut yevesha uveferot yeveshin, aval lo bichsut lacha velo beferot lachin. kesut lacha mechamat atzmah hechi mashkachat la? — mimmirta devene atme.
Mishna tomnin bichsut uveferot, bechanfe yona uvinsoret shel charashim uvinoret shel pishtan dakka. rabbi yehuda oser baddakka umattir baggassa.
Gemara amar rabbi yannay: tefillin tzerichin guf naki keelisha "baal kenafayim". may hi? abbaye amar: shello yafiach bahen. rava amar: shello yishan bahen.

Veammay kare leh "baal kenafayim"? — sheppaam achat gazra malchut romi harshaa shemad al yisrael shekkol hammanniach tefillin yenakkeru et mocho, vehaya elisha mannicham veyotze lashshuk. raahu kasdor echad ratz mippanav veratz acharav. vechevan shehiggia etzlo netalan merosho vaachazan beyado. amar lo: ma ze beyadcha? amar lo: kanfe yona. pashat et yado venimtzeu kanfe yona. lefichach korin oto "elisha baal kenafayim".

Umay shena kanfe yona mishshear ofot? mishshum deimmetil keneset yisrael leyona, shenneemar: "kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef vegomer" — ma yona kenafeha meginnot aleha, af yisrael mitzvot meginnot alehen.
Binsoret shel charashin kulei. ibbaya lehu: rabbi yehuda annesoret shel charashin kae, o anneoret shel pishtan kae?
Ta shema, detanya rabbi yehuda omer: neoret shel pishtan dakka hare hi kezevel. shema minna anneoret shel pishtan kae. shema minna.
Mishna tomnin beshilchin umetaltelin otan, begizze tzemer veen metaltelin otan. ketzad hu ose? notel et hakkissuy, vehen noflot.
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: kuppa, mattah al tziddah venotel, shemma yittol veeno yachol lehachazir. vachachamim omrim: notel umachazir.

Gemara yatev rabbi yonatan ben achinay verabbi yonatan ben elazar, veyatev rabbi chanina bar chama gabbayyhu, veka mibbaya lehu: shelachin shel baal habbayit tenan, aval shel umman kevan dekafed alayyhu la metaltelinan lehu. o dilma shel umman tenan, vechol shekken shel baal habbayit?
Amar lehu rabbi yonatan ben elazar: mistabbera shel baal habbayit tenan, aval shel umman kafed alayyhu. amar lehu rabbi chanina bar chama, kach amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose:
b: Abba — shallacha hava, veamar haviu shelachin veneshev alehen.
Metivi: nesarin shel baal habbayit metaltelin otan, veshel umman en metaltelin otan. veim chishshev latet alehen pat laorchin — ben kach uven kach metaltelin! shane nesarim dekafed alayyhu.

Ta shema: orot, ben avudin uven sheen avudin, muttar letaltelan beshabbat. lo amru avudin ella leinyan tumea bilvad. may lav la shena shel baal habbayit, vela shena shel umman? la, shel baal habbayit.

Aval shel umman may? en metaltelin — i hachi ha detane: velo amru avudin ella leinyan tumea bilvad, liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — beshel baal habbayit, aval beshel umman — lo! kulla bevaal habbayit kamayyre.
Ketannae: orot shel baal habbayit metaltelin otan, veshel umman en metaltelin otan. rabbi yose omer: echad ze veechad ze metaltelin otan.
Hadur yatvi vekamibbaya lehu: ha ditnan avot melachot arbaim chaser achat, keneged mi?

Amar lehu rabbi chanina bar chama: keneged avodot hammishkan. amar lehu rabbi yonatan berabbi elazar, kach amar rabbi shimon berabbi yose ben lakonya: keneged "melacha" "melachto" umelechet" shebbattora arbaim chaser achat.

Bae rav yosef: "vayyavo habbayta laasot melachto", mimminyana hu, o la? amar leh abbaye: velayte sefer tora velimne. mi la amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan lo zazu mishsham ad sheheviu sefer tora umenaum!
Amar leh: ki ka mesappeka li mishshum dichtiv: "vehammelacha hayta dayyam" mimminyana hu — veha keman deamar laasot tzerachav nichnas.
O dilma "vayyavo habbayta laasot melachto" mimminyana hu, vehay "vehammelacha hayta dayyam" — hachi kaamar: dishlima leh avidta. teku.
Tanya keman deamar keneged avodot hammishkan. detanya: en chayyayvin ella al melacha shekkayyotze bah hayta bammishkan. hem zaru, veattem lo tizreu. hem katzru, veattem lo tiktzeru.

Hem heelu et hakkerashim mikkarka laagala, veattem lo tachnisu mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid. hem horidu et hakkerashim meagala lekarka, veattem lo totziu mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. hem hotziu meagala laagala, veattem lo totziu mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid.
Mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid may ka aved? abbaye verava deamri tarvavyhu, veittema rav adda bar ahava: mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derech reshut harabbim.
Begizze tzemer veen metaltelin. amar rava: lo shanu ella shello taman bahen, aval taman bahen — metaltelin otan.
Etiveh hahu merabbanan bar yomeh lerava: tomnin begizze tzemer veen metaltelin otan. ketzad hu ose?

a: Notel et hakkissuy, vehen noflot.
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rava lo shanu ella shello yichadan lehatemana. aval yichadan lehatemana — metaltelin otan.
Ittemar name, ki ata ravin amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi assi ben shaul amar rabbi: lo shanu ella shello yichadan lehatemana, aval yichadan lehatemana — metaltelin otan.
Ravina omer: beshel heftek shanu. tanya name hachi, gizze tzemer shel heftek en metaltelin otan. veim hitkinan baal habbayit lehishtammesh bahen — metaltelin otan.

Tana rabba bar bar channa kammeh derav: chariyyot shel dekel sheggedaran leetzim, venimlach alehen lishiva — tzarich lekashsher. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en tzarich lekashsher. hu tane la vehu amar la: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Ittemar rav amar: kosher, ushemuel amar: choshev, verav assi amar: yoshev, af al pi shello kishsher veaf al pi shello chishshev.
Bishlama rav hu deamar ketanna kamma, ushemuel name hu deamar kerabban shimon ben gamliel. ella rav assi deamar keman?

Hu deamar ki hay tanna detanya: yotzin befakorin uvetzifa, bizman shetztzevaan beshemen ucherachan bimshicha. lo tzevaan beshemen velo kerachan bimshicha — en yotzin bahem. veim yatza bahen shaa achat mibbeod yom, af al pi shello tzava velo kerachan bimshicha muttar latzet bahen.

Amar rav ashe, af anan name tenena: hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta lo yenaneennu beyado, aval menaano begufo. aval im haya alav maachal behema, o shehaya alav kar o sadin mibbeod yom — menaano beyado. shema minna.

Uman tena diflig aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel — rabbi chanina ben akiva. dechi ata rav dimi, amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: paam achat halach rabbi chanina ben akiva lemakom echad, umatza chariyyot shel dekel sheggedarum leshum etzim, veamar lahem letalmidav: tzeu vechashshevu kede shenneshev alehen lemachar. vela yadana i bet hammishte hava, i bet haevel hava.
Middekaamar i bet hammishte hava i bet haevel hava — davka bet haevel o bet hammishte ditridi, aval hacha kashar — in, lo kashar — la.
Amar rav yehuda: machnis adam melo kuppato afar, veose bah kol tzarko. daresh mar zutera mishshemeh demar zutera rabba: vehu sheyyiched lo keren zavit.
Amaru rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: keman — kerabban shimon ben gamliel. dei kerabbanan — haamri baenan maase.
Amar lehu rav pappa: afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan devaenan maase ella midde devar mebad beh maase, aval midde dela bar mebad beh maase — la.
Nema ketannae: bakkol chofin et hakkelim chutz mikkele chesef bigratkon. ha neter vachol muttar.
Vehatanya: neter vachol — asur. may lav beha kamippalgi: demar savar baenan maase, umar savar la baenan maase.
La, dechulle alma la baenan maase, vela kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbi shimon.
Ha rabbi yehuda, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven — asur. ha rabbi shimon, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven — muttar.
Bemay okemta leha deshare — kerabbi shimon, ema sefa: aval lo yachof bahem searo, vei rabbi shimon — mishra kashare. ditnan:
b: Nazir chofef umefaspes, aval lo sorek!
Ella ha veha rabbi yehuda hi, utere tannae allibba derabbi yehuda. hay tanna allibba derabbi yehuda savar garer, vehay tanna allibba derabbi yehuda savar la garer.
Bemay okemta — kerabbi yehuda, ema sefa: aval panav yadav veraglav muttar. ha meabbar sear!
Ibbaet ema bekatan, veibbaet ema baishsha, veibbaet ema besaris.
Amar rav yehuda: afar leventa shere. amar rav yosef: kusepa deyasmin shere. amar rava: afar pilpele shere. amar rav sheshet: barda shere.
May barda? amar rav yosef: tilleta ahala vetilta asa vetilta sigle. amar rav nechemya bar yosef: kol hecha delekka rubba ahala — shappir dame.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: mahu liftzoa zetim beshabbat? amar lehu vechi bechol mi hittiru? kasavar mishshum hefsed ochalin.
Lema peliga dishmuel, deamar shemuel: ose adam kol tzorko befat! amri: pat la meisa, hane meise.

Ammemar umar zutera verav ashe havo yatvi, ayyto lekammayyhu barda. ammemar verav ashe mesho, mar zutera la mesha. amaru leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rav sheshet barda shere?! amar lehu rav mardochay: bar minneh demar, daafillu bechol name la sevira leh.
Savar la ki ha detanya: megarer adam gilde tzoa vegilde makka sheal besaro bishvil tzaaro, im bishvil leyappot — asur.
Veinhu keman savruha? — ki ha detanya: rochetz adam panav yadav veraglav bechol yom bishvil kono, mishshum shenneemar: "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu".

Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: kuppa, mattah al tziddah venotel, shemma yittol vechulei. amar rabbi abba amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: hakkol modim sheim nitkalkela haggumma — sheasur lehachazir.
Tenan, vachachamim omrim: notel umachazir. hechi dame? i dela nitkalkela haggumma — shappir ka amri rabbanan. ella lav, af al pi denitkalkela haggumma.
La, leolam dela nitkalkela, vehacha bechoshshin kamippalgi. mar savar choshshin shemma nitkalkela haggumma, umar savar en choshshin.
Amar rav huna: hay selikuseta — datza, shalfa, vahadar datza — shere. vei lav, asir.
Amar shemuel: hay sakkina devene ureve — datza, shalfah, vahadar datza — shere. vei lav asir.
Mar zutera, veittema rav ashe amar: beguredyata dikne shappir dame.
Amar leh rav mardochay lerava, metiv rav kattina teyuveta: hattomen lefet utzenonot tachat haggefen, im haya miktzat alav megullim — eno choshesh

a: Lo mishshum kilayim, velo mishshum sheviit, velo mishshum maaser, venittalin beshabbat! teyuveta.
Mishna lo kissahu mibbeod yom — lo yechassennu mishshettechshach. kissahu venitgalla, muttar lechassoto. memalle et hakkiton venoten letachat hakkar o tachat hakkeset.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: muttar lehatemin et hatztzonen. amar rav yosef: may kamashma lan? tenena: memalle adam kiton venoten tachat hakkar o tachat hakkeset!
Amar leh abbaye: tuva kamashma lan, dei mimmatni hava amena hane mille — davar sheen darko lehatemin, aval davar sheddarko lehatemin la — kamashma lan.

Amar rav huna amar rav: asur lehatemin et hatztzonen. vehatanya: rabbi hittir lehatemin et hatztzonen! la kashya, ha mikkammeh delishmeeh merabbi yishmael berabbi yose, ha levatar delishmeeh. ki ha deyatev rabbi veamar: asur lehatemin et hatztzonen. amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: abba hittir lehatemin et hatztzonen. amar: kevar hora zaken.

Amar rav pappa: bo uree kamma mechabbevin ze et ze. sheillu rabbi yose kayyaym, haya kafuf veyoshev lifne rabbi. deha rabbi yishmael berabbi yose dimmalle mekom avotav hava, vechafuf veyoshev lifne rabbi, vekaamar: kevar hora zaken.

Amar leh rav nachman ledaru avdeh: atmen li tzonen, veayyti li mayya deachem kappila arammaa. shema rabbi amme veikkefad. amar rav yosef: may tama ikkefad? kerabbevoteh aved — chada kerav, vachada kishmuel.
Kishmuel — deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: muttar lehatemin et hatztzonen. kerav — deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: kol shehu neechol kemot shehu chay — en bo mishshum bishshule goyim.
(Hu) savar adam chashuv shane.

Tanu rabbanan: af al pi sheamru en tomnin afillu bedavar sheeno mosif hevel mishshechashecha, im ba lehosif — mosif. ketzad hu ose? rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: notel et hassedinin umanniach et haggelufekrin, o notel et haggelufekrin umanniach et hassedinin.
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo asru ella oto mecham, aval pinna mimmecham lemecham — muttar. hasheta okore ka meker lehu, artoche ka martach lehu?!
Taman vechissa bedavar hannittal beshabbat, o taman bedavar sheeno nittal beshabbat vechissa bedavar hannittal beshabbat — hare ze notel umachazir.
Taman vechissa bedavar sheeno nittal beshabbat o shettaman bedavar hannittal beshabbat, vechissa bedavar sheeno nittal beshabbat, im haya megulle miktzato notel umachazir. veim lav —
b: Eno notel umachazir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: neoret shel pishtan dakka hare hi kezevel.

Mannichin mecham al gabbe mecham ukedera al gabbe kedera, aval lo kedera al gabbe mecham, umecham al gabbe kedera. vetach et piha bevatzek, velo bishvil sheyyechammu, ella bishvil sheyyihyu meshummarim.
Ucheshem sheen tomnin et hachammin kach en tomnin et hatztzonen. rabbi hittir lehatemin et hatztzonen.
Veen merazzekin lo et hashsheleg velo et habbarad beshabbat bishvil sheyyazuvu memav, aval noten hu letoch hakkos o letoch hakkeara veeno choshesh.
Haderan alach bema tomnin
Mishna bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza? — yotze haggamal beafsar, venaaka bachatam, veluvedkim bifrumebya, vesus besher.
Vechol baale hashsher yotzin besher venimshachin besher.
Umazzin alehen, vetovlan bimkoman.
Gemara may "naka bachatam"? amar rabba bar bar chana: nakta chivvarti bizmama defarzela. "veluvedkim bifrumebya" — amar rav huna: chamara luva befagge defarzela.
Levi shaddar zuze leve chozae lemizban leh chamara luva. tzaru shaddaru leh seare, lememar denigre dachamara seare.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: machlifin lifne rabbi, shel zo bazo mahu?
Naka beafsar la tibbee lach, kevan dela minnatra beh — massooy hu. ki tibbee lach gamal bachatam may? kevan desaggi leh beafsar — massooy hu, o dilma netiruta yattirta la amrinan massooy hu?
Amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: kach amar abba: arba behemot yotzot beafsar, hassus vehappered vehaggamal vehachamor. lemaote may? lav lemaote gamal bachatam! la, lemaote naka beafsar.
Bematnita tana: luvedkim vegamal yotzin beafsar. ketannae: en chayya yotza besugar, chananya omer: yotza besugar uvechol davar hammishtammer.
Bemay askinan? illema bechayya gedola — mi saggi la sugar? veella bechayya ketanna — mi la saggi la sugar?

Ella lav chatul ikka benayyhu: tanna kamma savar kevan desaggi la bemitna bealma massooy hu, vachananya savar kol netiruta yattirta la amrinan massooy hu. amar rav huna bar chiyyay amar shemuel: halacha kachananya.
Levi bereh derav huna bar chiyyay verabba bar rav huna havo kaazli beorcha. kadmeh chamara delevi lachamara derabbah bar rav huna. chalash dateh derabba bar rav huna, amar: ema leh milleta ki hechi

a: Detittotav dateh. amar leh: chamor sheasakav raim kegon ze, mahu latzet bifrumebya beshabbat? amar leh: hachi amar avuch mishshemeh dishmuel: halacha kachananya.

Tana deve menashsheya: ez shechakak lah ben karneha yotza beafsar beshabbat. bae rav yosef: tachav lah bizkanah mahu? kevan dei menattach la kaev la la atya lenattoche, o dilma zimnin derafe venafel, veate leetuye arba ammot birshut harabbim. teku.
Tenan hatam: velo birtzua shebben karneha. amar (leh) rabbi yirmeya bar abba: peligi ba rav ushemuel. chad amar: ben lenoy ben leshammer — asur. vechad amar: lenoy — asur, uleshammer — muttar.
Amar rav yosef: tistayyem dishmuel hu deamar lenoy asur, leshammer muttar. deamar rav huna bar chiyyay amar shemuel: halacha kachananya.

Amar leh abbaye: adderabba, tistayyem dishmuel hu deamar ben lenoy ben leshammer — asur. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: machlifin lifne rabbi, shel zo bezo mahu? amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, kach amar abba: arba behemot yotzot beafsar — hassus happered vehaggamal vehachamor. lav lemaote gamal bachatam? sami ha mikkamme ha.

Umay chazet dimsammet ha mikkamme ha? sami ha mikkamme ha! (deashkechan shemuel hu deamar lenoy asur leshammer muttar. deittemar:) rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: ben lenoy ben leshammer — asur. verav chiyyay bar avin amar shemuel: lenoy — asur, leshammer — muttar.
Metivi: kesharah bealeha bemosera — keshera. vei salka datach massooy hu, "asher lo ala aleha ol" amar rachamana!
Amar abbaye: bemolichah meir lair. rava amar: shane para dedameha yekarin. ravina amar: bemoredet.
Hassus besher vechulei. may "yotzin"? umay "nimshachin"? amar rav huna: o yotzin keruchin, o nimshachin. ushemuel amar: yotzin nimshachin, veen yotzin keruchin.
Bematnita tana: yotzin keruchin limmashech. amar rav yosef: chazena lehu leigle deve rav huna yotzin beafserehen keruchin beshabbat.
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi chanina: mulaot shel bet rabbi yotzot beafserehen beshabbat. ibbaya lehu: keruchin o nimshachin?
Ta shema, ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi chanina: mulaot shel bet rabbi yotzot beafserehen keruchim beshabbat.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav assi: ha derav shemuel bar yehuda la tzericha, midderav dimi nafka. dei salka datach derav dimi "nimshachin" kaamar, midderav yehuda amar shemuel nafka.

Deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: machlifin hayu lifne rabbi, shel zo bazo mahu? amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, kach amar abba: arba behemot yotzet baafsar, hassus vehappered vehaggamal vehachamor.
Amar lehu rav assi: itzterich lehu. dei midderav yehuda nafka, hava amena: amar lefanav vela kaybla minneh. ka mashma lan derav dimi.
Vei derav dimi, hava amena: hane mille nimshachin, aval keruchin — la, ka mashma lan derav shemuel bar rav yehuda.
Umazzin alehen vetovlan bimkoman. lememra divne kabbole tumea ninhu? vehatnan: tabbaat adam — temea, vetabbaat behema vechelim ushear kol hattabbaot —
b: Tehorot.
Amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: bevain minnoy adam lenoy behema.
Verav yosef amar: hoil veadam moshech bahem et habbehema. mi la tanya: makkel shel behema, shel mattechet mekabbel tumea. ma taam? — hoil veadam rodah bahen. hacha name, hoil veadam moshech bahen.
Vetovlan bimkoman: vehaikka chatzitza!
Amar rabbi amme: besherittechan.
Lema rabbi amme kerav yosef sevira leh, dei kerabbi yitzchak nappacha, deamar: bevain minnoy adam lenoy behema — kevan derittechan, avad behu maase uferacha la tumea minnayyhu.
Ditnan: kol hakkelim yordin lide tumeatan bemachshava, veen olin mittumeatan ella beshinnuy maase!
Savar la kerabbi yehuda deamar maase letakken lav maase hu. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: lo amru shinnuy maase letakken ella lekalkel.
Bematnita tane bimchullalin.
Shaal talmid echad miggalil haelyon et rabbi eliezer: shamati shecholkin ben tabbaat letabbaat. amar lo: shemma lo shamata ella leinyan shabbat. dei leinyan tumea, da veda chada hi.
Uleinyan tumea da veda achat hi? vehatnan: tabbaat adam temea, vetabbaat behema vechelim ushear kol hattabbaot tehorot! ki kaamar leh ihu, name deadam kaamar leh.
Udeadam, da veda achat hi? vehatanya: tabbaat shehitkina lachgor bah motnav ulekashsher bah ben ketefav — tehora, velo amru temea ella shel etzba bilvad! ki kaamar leh ihu, name deetzba kaamar leh.
Udeetzba da veda achat hi? vehatnan: tabbaat shel mattechet vechotamah shel almog — temea. hi shel almog vechotamah shel mattechet — tehora! ki kaamar leh ihu, name kullah shel mattechet kaamar leh.
Veod shaal: shamati shecholkin ben machat lemachat. amar lo: shemma lo shamat ella leinyan shabbat, dei leinyan tumea da veda achat hi.
Uleinyan tumea da veda achat hi? vehatnan: machat shennittal chorah o uketzah — tehora! ki kaamar leh bishlema.

Uvishlema da veda achat hi? vehatnan: machat sheheelta chaluda, im meakkev et hattefira — tehora, veim lav — temea. veamri deve rabbi yannay: vehu sherishshumah nikkar! ki kaamar leh, beshifa kaamar leh.
Uveshifa da veda achat hi? vehatanya: machat ben nekuva ben enah nekuva muttar letaltelah beshabbat, vela amrinan nekuva ella leinyan tumea bilvad!
Ha targema abbaye allibba derava — begulme.

Mishna chamor yotze bammardaat bizman shehi keshura bo. zecharim yotzin levuvin. rechelot yotzot shechuzot, kevulot uchevunot. haizzim yotzot tzerurot. rabbi yose oser bechullan, chutz min harchelin hakkevunot.
Rabbi yehuda omer: izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh, aval lo lechalev.

a: Gemara amar shemuel: vehu shekkeshura lo meerev shabbat. amar rav nachman: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: en hachamor yotze bammardaat bizman sheenah keshura lo.
Hechi dame? illema sheenah keshura lo kelal — peshita, dilma nafla leh veate leetuye. ella lav sheenah keshura meerev shabbat. mikkelal deresha, shekkeshura lo meerev shabbat. shema minna.

Tanya name hachi: chamor yotze bammardaat bizman shekkeshura lo meerev shabbat, velo baukkaf af al pi shekkashur lo meerev shabbat. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af baukkaf bizman shekkashur lo meerev shabbat, uvilvad shello yikshor lo masrechan, uvilvad shello yifshol lo retzua tachat zenavo.
Bea minneh rav assi bar natan merabbi chiyyay bar rav ashe: mahu litten mardaat al gabbe chamor beshabbat? amar leh: muttar. amar leh: vechi ma ben ze leukkaf? ishtik.
Etiveh: ukkaf sheal gabbe chamor — lo yetaltelennu beyado, ella molichah umeviah bechatzer vehu nofel meelav. hasheta littol amrat la, lehanniach mibbaya?!

Amar leh rabbi zera: shivkeh, kerabbeh sevira leh, deamar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: tolin teraskal livhema beshabbat, vekal vachomer lemardaat. uma hatam demishshum taanug shere, hacha demishshum tzaar — lo kol shekken.
Shemuel amar: mardaat muttar, teraskal — asur. azal rabbi chiyyay bar yosef amra lishmata derav kammeh dishmuel. amar leh: i hachi amar abba, la yada bemille deshabbeta vela kelum.
Ki salek rabbi zera, ashkecheh lerabbi binyamin bar yefet deyatev vekaamar leh mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: notnin mardaat al gabbe chamor beshabbat. amar leh: yishar, vechen targema aryoch bevavel.
"Aryoch" mannu — shemuel. veha rav name amra? ella shameh dahava mesayyem ba: veen tolin teraskal beshabbat, amar leh: yishar, vechen targema aryoch bevavel.
Dechulle alma mihat mardaat muttar, may shena meukkaf? — shane hatam deefshar denafel mimmela.
Rav pappa amar: kan lechammemah, kan letzannenah. lechammemah, it la tzaara. letzannenah, let la tzaara. vehayeynu deamri inashe: chamara afillu bitkufat tammuz karir la.

Metivi: lo yetze hassus biznav shual, velo bazzaharurit shebben enav. lo yetze hazzav bakkis shello, velo izzim bakkis shebbedaddehen, velo para bachissum shebbefiha, velo seyaychim batteraskalin shebbefihem lirshut harabbim, velo behema bassandal shebberagleha, velo bakkamea af al pi shehu mumeche — veze chomer babbehema mibbaadam.
Aval yotze hu baeged sheal gabbe hammakka, uvakkeshishin sheal gabbe hashshever, uvashshilya hameduledelet bah, ufokkin lah zug betzavvarah, umetayyelet immo bechatzer.
Katane mihat: velo seyaychin bitraskalim shebbefihem lirshut harabbim. lirshut harabbim hu dela, ha bechatzer — shappir dame. may lav, bigdolim umishshum taanug?!
La, biktannim umishshum tzaar: dayka name, dekatane
b: Dumeya dekamea. shema minna.
Amar mar: velo bakkamea af al pi shehu mumeche. veha anan tenan: velo bakkamea sheeno mumeche. ha mumeche — shappir dame! hacha name sheeno mumeche.

Veha "af al pi shehu mumeche" katane! mumeche leadam veeno mumeche livhema. umi ikka mumeche leadam vela have mumeche livhema? in, adam deit leh mazzala — mesayyay leh, behema delet la mazzala — la mesayyay la.
I hachi, may "ze chomer babbehema mibbaadam"? mi savrat akkamea kae? assandal kae.
Ta shema: sachin umefarkesin leadam, veen sachin umefarkesin labbehema. may lav, deikka makka umishshum tzaar! la, digmar makka umishshum taanug.
Ta shema: behema sheachazah dam, en maamidin otah bemayim bishvil shettitztannen. adam sheachazo dam, maamidin oto bemayim bishvil sheyyitztannen. amar ulla: gezera mishshum shechikat sammanin.
I hachi adam name! adam nire kemeker.
I hachi behema name nire kemeker! en meker livhema.
Velivhema mi gazrinan? vehatanya: hayta omedet chutz lattechum, kore lah vehi baa. vela gazrinan dilma ate leetuye.
Amar ravina: kegon shehaya techum shellah muvela betoch techum shello.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: shechikat sammanin gufa tannae hi. detanya: behema sheachla karshinin lo yeritzenna bechatzer bishvil shettitrappe, verabbi oshaya mattir. daresh rava: halacha kerabbi oshaya.
Amar mar: lo yetze hazzav bakkis shello, velo izzim bakkis shebbedaddehen. vehatanya: yotzot izzim bakkis shebbedaddehen!
Amar rav yehuda, la kashya: ha demihaddak, ha dela mihaddak.

Rav yosef amar: tannae shaklat mealma? tannae hi, ditnan: haizzim yotzot tzerurot, rabbi yose oser bechullan chutz min harchelot hakkevunot, rabbi yehuda omer: izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh, aval lo lechalev.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha rabbi yehuda, vela kashya: kan leyabbesh, kan lechalev.
Tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: maase beizzim shel antochya shehayu daddehen gassin, veasu lahen kisin kede shello yissartu daddehen.
Tanu rabbanan: maase beechad shemmeta ishto vehinnicha ben linak velo haya lo sechar menika litten, venaasa lo nes veniftechu lo daddin kishne dadde ishsha vehenik et beno.
Amar rav yosef: bo uree kamma gadol adam ze shennaasa lo nes kaze! amar leh abbaye: adderabba kamma garua adam ze shennishtannu lo sidre vereshit.
Amar rav yehuda: bo uree kamma kashim mezonotav shel adam, shennishtannu alav sidre vereshit. amar rav nachman: tidda, demitrechish nissa vela ibberu mezone.

Tanu rabbanan: maase beadam echad shennasa ishsha giddemet velo hikkir bah ad yom motah. amar rav: bo uree kamma tzenua ishsha zo shello hikkir bah baalah. amar lo rabbi chiyyay: zo darkah bechach. ella: kamma tzanua adam ze shello hikkir beishto.
Zecharim yotzin levuvin. may "levuvin"? amar rav huna: tutare. may mashma dehay "levuvin" lishshana dekarove hu — dichtiv: "libbavtini achoti challa".

Ulla amar: or shekkoshrin lahem keneged libbam — kede shello yippelu alehen zeevim. zeevim — azzecharim nafli, annekevot la nafli? mishshum dimsaggu beresh edra. uzeevin — beresh edra nafli, besof edra la nafli? ella: mishshum deshammine. uvinkevot lekka deshamminan? vetu, mi yadi ben hane lehane? ella mishshum dezakfi chutemayyhu umesaggu ki davu.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: or shekkoshrin lahen tachat zachrutan kede shello yaalu al hannekevot. mimmay? — middekatane sefa: veharchelim yotzot shechuzot. may "shechuzot" — sheochazin haalya shellahen lemala kede sheyyaalu alehen zecharim. resha kede shello yaalu al hannekevot, vesefa kede sheyyaalu alehen zecharim.
May mashma dehay "shechuzot" lishshana degalloye hu? — dichtiv: "vehinne ishsha likrato

a: Shit zona unetzurat lev".

Harchelim yotzot kevulot. may "kevulot"? — shemmechabbelin alya shellahen lematta kede shello yaalu alehen zecharim. may mashma dehay "kavul" lishshana dela aved pere hu — dichtiv: "ma hearim [haelle] asher natatta li achi vayyikra lahen eretz kavul ad hayyom hazze".

May "eretz kavul"? amar rav huna: shehayu bah bene adam shemmechubbalin bechesef uvezahav. amar leh rava: i hachi, hayeynu dichtiv: "(ki lo) yashru beenav" — mippene shemmechubbalin bechesef uvezahav lo yashru beenav? amar leh: in, kevan deattire umefanneki, la avdi avidta.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: eretz chomton hayta. veammay kare la "kavul" — demistarga ba kara ad kavla. veamri inashe: ara mechabbalta dela avda pere.
Kevunot. may "kevunot"? — shemchabbenin otan lemelat. keditnan: seet — ketzemer lavan. may tzemer lavan? amar rav bivi bar abbaye: ketzemer naki ben yomo shemchabbenin oto lemelat.
Vehaizzim yotzot tzerurot. ittemar, rav amar: halacha kerabbi yehuda, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi yose.
Veikka dematne leha shemata beappe nafshay. rav amar: leyabbesh muttar velo lechalev, ushemuel amar: echad ze veechad ze asur.

Veikka dematne la aha: izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh aval lo lechalev. mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betera amru: kach halacha, aval mi mefis ezo leyabbesh veezo lechalev? umittoch sheen makkirim, echad ze veechad ze asur. amar shemuel: veamri la amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betera. ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: halacha ketanna kamma.
Mishna uvamma enah yotza? — lo yetze gamal bimtuletelet, lo akud velo ragul, vechen shear kol habbehemot.
Lo yikshor gemallim ze baze veyimshoch, aval machnis chavalim letoch yado veyimshoch, uvilvad shello yichroch.

Gemara: tana lo yetze haggamal bimtuletelet hakkeshura lo biznavo, aval yotze hu bimtuletelet hakkeshura biznavo uvechotarto. amar rabba bar rav huna: yotze haggamal bimtuletelet hakkeshura lo beshilyeyta.
Lo akud velo ragul. amar rav yehuda: "akud" — akedat yad varegel, keyitzchak ben avraham. "ragul" — shello yachof yado al gabbe zeroo veyikshor.

Metivi: "akud" — shete yadayim ushete raglayim. "ragul" — shello yachof yado al gabbe zeroo veyikshor! hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: "akud" — akedat yad varegel o shete yadayim ushete raglayim, "ragul" — shello yachof yado al gabbe zeroo veyikshor.
Veakkatti la dame: bishlama resha vesefa — nicha, metziata kashya!
Ella hu deamar ki hay tanna, "akud" — akedat yad varegel, keyitzchak ben avraham. "ragul" — shello yachof yado al gabbe zeroo veyikshor.
Velo yikshor gemallim. may tama? amar rav ashe: mishshum demechze keman deazel lechinga.
Aval machnis. amar rav ashe: lo shanu ella leinyan kilayim. kilayim demay? illema kilayim deadam, vehatnan: adam muttar im kullam lacharosh velimshoch!
Ella kilayim dachavalim. vehatanya: hattochef techifa achat — enah chibbur?
Leolam kilayim dachavalim, vehachi kaamar: uvilvad shello yichroch veyikshor.
Amar shemuel: uvilvad shello yetze [chevel] mittachat yado tefach. veha tana deve shemuel tifchayim!
Amar abbaye: hasheta deamar shemuel tefach, vetana deve shemuel tifchayim — shemuel halacha lemaase ata leashmoinan.
b: Vehatanya: uvilvad sheyyagbiah min hakkarka tefach! ki tanya hahi bechavla devene bene.
Mishna en chamor yotze bammardaat bizman sheenah keshura lo, velo bazzug af al pi shehu pakuk, velo besullam shebbetzavvaro, velo birtzua shebberaglo.
Veen hattarnegolim yotzin bechutin velo birtzua shebberaglehem, veen hazzecharim yotzin baagala shettachat haalya shellahen.

Veen harchelim yotzot chanunot, veen haegel yotze begimon, velo para beor hakkuppar, velo birtzua shebben karneha. parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayta yotza birtzua shebben karneha shello birtzon chachamim.
Gemara may tama — kedaamaran.
Velo bazzug af al pi shehu pakuk: mishshum demechze keman deazel lechinga.
Velo besullam shebbetzavvaro: amar rav huna: be loa. lemay avdi leh? — lehecha deit leh makka, dela hadar chayech bay.
Velo birtzua shebberaglo: deavdi leh legizra.
Veen hattarnegolin yotzin bechutin: deavdi lehu simana ki hechi dela lichlefu.
Velo birtzua: deavdi lehu ki hechi dela litberu mane. veen hazzecharim yotzin baagala: ki hechi dela lichmetan alyaytayhu.

Veen harchelim yotzot chanunot: yatev rav acha bar ulla kammeh derav chisda veyatev vekaamar: mishshaa sheggozzin otah tomnin lah ezek beshemen umannichin lah al paddachtah kede shello titztannen. amar leh rav chisda: im ken, asitah mar ukeva.

Ella yatev rav pappa bar shemuel kammeh derav chisda veyatev vekaamar: beshaa shekkoraat leled tomnin lah shene azakin shel shemen, umannichin lah echad al paddachtah veechad al harechem kede shettitchammem. amar leh rav nachman: im ken, asitah yalta.

Ella amar rav huna: etz echad yesh bichrakke hayyam veyachnun" shemo, umeviin kesam umannichin lah bechotmah kede shettitattesh veyippelu darne roshah. i hachi zecharim name! kevan dimnaggeche zecharim bahadade mimmela naflan. shimon nezira amar: kisma deritma.
Bishlama derav huna, hayeynu dekatane "chanunot", ella lerabbanan may "chanunot"? deavdinan lehu milleta dimrachaminan alayyhu.
Veen haegel yotze begimon. may egel begimon? amar rav huna: bar nira. amar rabbi elazar: may mashma dehay "gimon" lishshana demechaf — dichtiv: "halachof keagmon rosho".
Velo para beor hakkuppar: deavdi lah ki hechi dela limtzeyuha yale.
Velo birtzua shebben karneha. i lerav deamar ben lenoy ben leshammer — asur. i lishmuel deamar lenoy — asur, leshammer — muttar.
Parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya: vachada para haveya leh? veha amar rav, veamri lah amar rav yehuda amar rav: teresar alfe igle hava meassar rabbi elazar ben azarya meedreh kol shatta veshatta.
Tana: lo shello hayta ella shel shechento hayta, umittoch shello micha bah nikret al shemo.

Rav verabbi chanina verabbi yochanan verav chaviva matnu: bechulleh deseder moed kol ki hay zuga challofe rabbi yochanan umeayyel rabbi yonatan. kol mi sheefshar limchot leanshe veto velo micha — nitpas al anshe veto. beanshe iro — nitpas al anshe iro. bechol haolam kullo — nitpas al kol haolam kullo.
Amar rav pappa: vehane deve resh galuta mittafsu akkulle alma. ki ha deamar rabbi chanina: may dichtiv "Adonai bammishpat yavo im zikne ammo vesarav" — im sarim chatu,

a: Zekenim me chatu? ella ema: al zekenim, shello michu bassarim.

Rav yehuda hava yatev kammeh dishmuel. atay hahi itteta ka tzavvcha kammeh, vela hava mashgach ba. amar leh: la savar leh mar: "otem ozno mizzaakat dal gam hu yikra velo yeane"? amar leh: shinnana, reshach bekarire, resha dereshaych bechammime. ha yatev mar ukeva av bet din.
Dichtiv: "bet david ko amar Adonai dinu labboker mishpat vehatztzilu gazul miyyad oshek pen tetze chaesh chamati uvaara veen mechabbe mippene roa maallehem vegomer".
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi simon: lochchinhu mar lehane deve resh galuta. amar leh: la mekabbeli minnay. amar leh: af al gav dela mekabbeli lochchinhu mar.

Deamar rabbi acha berabbi chanina: meolam lo yatzta midda tova mippi hakkadosh baruch hu vechazar bah leraa chutz middavar ze, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai elav avor betoch hair betoch yerushalaym vehitvita tav al mitzchot haanashim hanneenachim vehanneenakim al kol hattoevot hannaasot betochah vegomer".

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu legavriel: lech ureshom al mitzchan shel tzaddikim tav shel deyo shello yishletu bahem malache chabbala. veal mitzcham shel reshaim tav shel dam kede sheyyishletu bahen malache chabbala.

Amra middat haddin lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam! ma nishtannu ellu meellu? amar lah: hallalu tzaddikim gemurim vehallalu reshaim gemurim. amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam! haya beyadam limchot velo michu!
Amar lah: galuy veyadua lefanay sheim michu bahem lo yekabbelu mehem. (amar) [amra] lefanav: ribbono shel olam! im lefanecha galuy, lahem mi galuy?

Vehayeynu dichtiv: "zaken bachur uvetula taf venashim tahargu lemashchit veal kol ish asher alav hattav al tiggashu umimmikdashi tachellu". uchetiv: "vayyachellu baanashim hazzekenim asher lifne habbayit". tane rav yosef: al tikre "mikdashi" ella "mekuddashay" — ellu bene adam shekkiyyemu et hattora kullah mealef vead tav. umiyyad: "vehinne shishsha anashim baim midderech shaar haelyon asher mofne tzafona veish keli mappatzo beyado veish echad betocham lavush habbaddim vekeset hassofer bemotnav vayyavou vayyaamdu etzel mizbach hannechoshet".

Mizbeach hannechoshet mi hava? amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: hatechilu mimmekom sheomrim shira lefanay. uman ninhu shishsha anashim? amar rav chisda: ketzef, af, vechema, umashchit, umeshabber, umechalle.
Umay shena "tav"? amar rav: "tav" — tichye, "tav" — tamut. ushemuel amar: tamma zechut avot. verabbi yochanan amar: tachon zechut avot.

Veresh lakish amar: "tav" — sof chotamo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, deamar rabbi chanina: chotamo shel hakkadosh baruch hu "emet". (amar) rabbi shemuel bar nachmani [amar]: ellu bene adam shekkiyyemu et hattora kullah mealef vead tav.
Meematay tamma zechut avot? amar rav: mimot hoshea ben beeri, shenneemar: "agalle et navlutah leene meahaveha veish lo yatztzilenna miyyadi".

Ushemuel amar: mime chazael, shenneemar: "vachazael melech aram lachatz et yisrael kol yeme yehoachaz". uchetiv: "vayyachon Adonai otam vayrachamem vayyifen alehem lemaan berito et avraham yitzchak veyaakov velo ava hashechitam velo hishlicham meal panav ad atta".

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: mime eliyyahu, shenneemar: "vayhi baalot hammincha vayyiggash eliyyahu hannavi vayyomar Adonai elohe avraham yitzchak veyisrael hayyom yivvada ki atta elohim beyisrael vaani avdecha uvidvarcha asiti [et] kol haddevarim haelle vegomer".

Verabbi yochanan amar: mime chizkiyyahu, shenneemar: "lemarbe hammisra uleshalom en ketz al kisse david veal mamlachto lehachin otah ulesaadah bemishpat uvitzdaka meatta vead olam kinat Adonai tzevaot taase zot vegomer".
Amar rav amme: en mita belo chet, veen yissurin belo avon.

En mita belo chet — dichtiv: "hannefesh hachotet hi tamut ben lo yissa baavon haav veav lo yissa baavon habben tzidkat hatztzaddik alav tihye verishat harasha alav tihye vegomer". en yissurin belo avon — dichtiv: "ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim avonam".
b: Metivi: amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam! mippene ma kanasta mita al adam harishon? amar lahem: mitzva kalla tzivvitiv veavar aleha. amru lo: vahalo moshe veaharon shekkiyyemu kol hattora kullah, umetu! amar lahem: "mikre echad latztzaddik velarasha lattov vegomer"!
Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af moshe veaharon bechetam metu, shenneemar: "yaan lo heemantem bi". ha heemantem bi — adayin lo higgia zemannechem lippater min haolam.

Metivi: arbaa metu beetyo shel nachash, veellu hen: binyamin ben yaakov, veamram avi moshe, veyishay avi david, vechilav ben david. vechullehu gemara, levar miyyishay avi david dimfaresh bah kera, dichtiv: "veet amasa sam avshalom tachat yoav (sar) [al] hatztzava vaamasa ven ish ushemo yitra hayyisreeli asher ba el avigayil bat nachash achot tzeruya em yoav".
Vechi bat nachash havay? vahalo bat yishay havay, dichtiv: "veachyotehen tzeruya vaavigayil". ella: bat mi shemmet beetyo shel nachash.
Manni? illema tanna demalache hashsharet, veha ikka moshe veaharon! ella lav, rabbi shimon ben elazar hi. ushema minna yesh mita belo chet veyesh yissurin belo avon, uteyuveta derav amme — teyuveta.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haomer reuven chata eno ella toe, shenneemar: "vayyihyu vene yaakov shenem asar" — melammed shekkullan shekulim keechad. ella ma ani mekayyem "vayyishkav et bilha pilegesh aviv" — melammed shebbilbel matztzao shel aviv, umaale alav hakkatuv keillu shachav immah.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: mutztzal oto tzaddik meoto avon, velo ba maase ze leyado. efshar atid zaro laamod al har eval velomar: "arur shochev im eshet aviv" veyavo chet ze leyado? ella ma ani mekayyem "vayyishkav et bilha pilegesh aviv" — elbon immo tava. amar: im achot immi hayta tzara leimmi, shifchat achot immi tehe tzara leimmi? amad uvilbel et matztzaah.
Acherim omrim: shete matztzaot bilbel, achat shel shechina veachat shel aviv. vehayeynu dichtiv: "az chillalta yetzui ala" — al tikre "yetzui" ella "yetzuayy".

Ketannae. "pachaz kammayim al totar". rabbi eliezer omer "pazzota", "chavta", "zalta". rabbi yehoshua omer: "pasata al dat", "chatata", "zanita". rabban gamliel omer: "pillalta", "chalta", "zarcha tefillatecha".

Amar rabban gamliel: adayin tzerichin anu lammodai. rabbi elazar hammodai omer: hafoch et hatteva vedorshah: "zizata", "hirtata", "parach chet mimmecha". rava amar, veamri le rabbi yirmeya bar abba: "zacharta onsho shel davar", "chillita atzmecha choli gadol", "perashta millachto".
Reuven. bene eli. bene shemuel. david ushelomo. veyoash. siman.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haomer bene eli chatu eno ella toe, shenneemar: "vesham shene vene eli im aron berit haelohim chofni ufinchas kohanim laAdonai".

Savar la kerav, deamar rav: pinchas lo chata. makkish chafni lefinchas: ma pinchas lo chata — af chafni lo chata. ella ma ani mekayyem "asher yishkevun et hannashim" — mittoch sheshshihu et kinnehen, shello halchu etzel baalehen, maale alehen hakkatuv keillu shechavum.
Gufa, amar rav: pinchas lo chata, shenneemar: "vaachiyya ven achituv achi i chavod ben pinchas ben eli kohen Adonai vegomer" — efshar chet ba leyado vehakkatuv meyaychaso?
