Vahalo kevar neemar: "yachret Adonai laish asher yaasenna er veone meohole yaakov umaggish mincha laAdonai tzevaot". im yisrael hu — lo yihye lo er bachachamim velo one battalmidim. veim kohen hu — lo yihye lo ben maggish mincha. ella lav shema minna: pinchas lo chata.
Ella ha chetiv "asher yishkevun"! — "yishkaven" ketiv.
Vehachtiv: "al banay ki lo tova hashshemua"! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "beni" ketiv.
Vehachtiv "maavirim"! amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: "maaviram" ketiv.
Vehachtiv "bene veliyyaal"! mittoch shehaya lo lefinchas lemachot lechofni velo micha, maale alav hakkatuv keillu chata.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haomer

a: Bene shemuel chatu eno ella toe, shenneemar: "vayhi (ki zaken shemuel uvanav lo halchu) bidrachav" — bidrachav hu delo halchu, michta name la chatu.

Ella ma ani mekayyem "vayyittu achare habbatza" — shello asu kemaase avihem, shehaya shemuel hatztzaddik mechazzer bechol mekomot yisrael vedan otam bearehem, shenneemar: "vehalach midde shana beshana vesavav bet el vehaggilgal vehammitzpa veshafat et yisrael", vehem lo asu ken, ella yashvu bearehem kede leharebot sachar lechazzanehen ulesofrehen.

Ketannae. "vayyittu achare habbatza", rabbi meir omer chelkam shaalu befihem. rabbi yehuda omer: melay hittilu al baale vattim. rabbi akiva omer: kuppa yetera shel maaser natlu bizroa. rabbi yose omer: mattanot natlu bizroa.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haomer david chata eno ella toe, shenneemar: "vayhi david lechol derachav maskil vaAdonai immo vegomer". efshar chet ba leyado ushechina immo?!
Ella ma ani mekayyem "maddua bazita et devar Adonai laasot hara" — shebbikkesh laasot velo asa.

Amar rav: rabbi deate middavid mehappech vedaresh bizchuteh dedavid. "maddua bazita et devar Adonai laasot hara" — rabbi omer: meshunna raa zo mikkol raot shebbattora, shekkol raot shebbattora ketiv behu "vayyaas", vechan ketiv "laasot" — shebbikkesh laasot velo asa.
"Et uriyya hachitti hikkita vacherev" — shehaya lecha leduno besanhedrin velo danta. "veet ishto lakachta lecha leishsha" — likkuchin yesh lecha bah.

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol hayyotze lemilchemet bet david, kotev get keritut leishto. shenneemar: "veet aseret charitze hechalav haelle tavi lesar haalef veet achecha tifkod leshalom veet arubbatam tikkach".
May "arubbatam"? — tane rav yosef: devarim hameoravim beno levenah.
"Veoto haragta becherev bene ammon" — ma cherev bene ammon i atta neenash alav, af uriyya hachitti i atta neenash alav.
May tama — mored bammalchut hava. daamar leh: "vadoni yoav veavde adoni al pene hassade chonim".
Amar rav: ki meayyeynat beh bedavid la mashkachat beh bar middeuriyya, dichtiv: "rak bidvar uriyya hachitti".
Abbaye kashshisha rame derav adderav: mi amar rav hachi? vehaamar rav: kibbel david lashon hara. kashya.

Gufa. rav amar: kibbel david lashon hara, dichtiv: "vayyomer lo hammelech efo hu vayyomer tziva el hammelech hinne hu bet machir ben ammiel belo devar". uchetiv: "vayyishlach hammelech vayyikkachehu mibbet machir ben ammiel millo devar".

Mikkedi chazyeh deshakkara hu, ki hadar alshen illaveh may tama kabbel minneh? dichtiv: "vayyomer hammelech el tziva ayye ben adonecha vayyomer tziva el hammelech hinne hu yoshev birushalayim vegomer". umena lan dekabbel minneh, dichtiv: "vayyomer hammelech hinne lecha kol asher limfivoshet vayyomer tziva hishtachaveti emtza chen beene hammelech".

Ushemuel amar: lo kibbel david lashon hara, devarim hannikkarim chaza beh. dichtiv: "umefivoshet ben shaul yarad lifne hammelech velo asa raglav velo asa sefamo veet begadav lo chibbes vegomer". uchetiv: "vayhi ki va yerushalaym likrat hammelech vayyomer lo hammelech lamma lo halachta immi mefivoshet. vayyomar adoni hammelech avdi rimmani ki amar avdecha echbesha li hachamor veerkav aleha veelech et hammelech ki fisseach
b: Avdecha. vayraggel beavdecha el adoni hammelech vadoni hammelech kemalach haelohim vaase hattov beenecha". "vayyomer lo hammelech lamma tedabber od devarecha amarti atta vetziva tachleku et hassade. vayyomer mefivoshet el hammelech gam et hakkol yikkach achare asher ba adoni hammelech beshalom el beto". amar lo: ani amarti "matay tavo beshalom", veatta ose li kach? lo alecha yesh li taromot ella al mi sheheviacha beshalom.

Hayeynu dichtiv: "uven yehonatan meriv baal", vechi "meriv baal" shemo? vahalo mefivoshet shemo! ella mittoch sheasa meriva im bealav. yatzta bat kol veamra lo: natztza bar natztza. "natztza" — ha daamaran. "bar natztza" — dichtiv: "vayyavo shaul ad ir amalek vayyarev bannachal", amar rabbi mani: al iske nachal.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa sheamar david limfivoshet: atta vetziva tachleku et hassade, yatzta bat kol veamra lo: rechavam veyaravam yachleku et hammelucha.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: ilmale lo kibbel david lashon hara lo nechleka malchut bet david, velo avdu yisrael avoda zara, velo galinu meartzenu.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haomer shelomo chata eno ella toe, shenneemar: "velo haya levavo shalem im Adonai elohav kilvav david aviv" — kilvav david aviv hu dela hava, michta name la chata.

Ella ma ani mekayyem "vayhi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et levavo" — hahi kerabbi natan. derabbi natan rame, ketiv: "vayhi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et levavo", vehachtiv: "kilvav david aviv" — kilvav david aviv hu dela hava michta name la chata! hachi kaamar: "vayhi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et levavo lalechet achare elohim acherim" — velo halach.
Vehachtiv: "az yivne shelomo bama lichmosh shikkutz moav" — shebbikkesh livnot velo bana.
Ella meatta: "az yivne yehoshua mizbeach laAdonai" — shebbikkesh livnot velo bana?! ella divna, hacha name divna!
Ella kidtanya, rabbi yose omer: "veet habbamot asher al pene yerushalaym asher mimin lehar hammishcha asher bana shelomo melech yisrael leashtoret shikkutz tzidonim vegomer".

Efshar ba asa velo biaram, yehoshafat velo biaram, ad shebba yoshiyya uviaram? vahalo kol avoda zara shebbeeretz yisrael asa vihoshafat biarum! ella makkish rishonim laacharonim, ma acharonim lo asu vetala bahen leshevach, af rishonim lo asu vetala bahen lignay.
Vehachtiv: "vayyaas shelomo hara beene Adonai"! ella mippene shehaya lo limchot benashav velo micha maale alav hakkatuv keillu chata.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: noach lo leoto tzaddik sheyyehe shammash ledavar acher, veal yikkatev bo "vayyaas hara beene Adonai".
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: beshaa shennasa shelomo et bat paro, hichnisa lo elef mine zemer, veamra lo kach osin laavoda zara pelonit, vechach osim laavoda zara pelonit, velo micha bah.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: beshaa shennasa shelomo et bat paro yarad gavriel venaatz kane bayyam veala bo sirton, vealav nivna kerach gadol [shel romi].
Bematnita tana: oto hayyom shehichnis yaravam shene egle zahav, echad bevet el veechad bedan, nivna tzerif echad, vezehu italya shel yavan.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol haomer yoshiyyahu chata — eno ella toe, shenneemar: "vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai vayyelech bechol derech david aviv". ella ma ani mekayyem "vechamohu lo haya lefanav melech asher shav vegomer"?
Shekkol din sheddan mibben shemone ad shemone esre hechziran lahen. shemma tomar natal mizze venatan laze — talmud lomar "bechol meodo": shennatan lahem mishshello.

Ufeliga derav, deamar rav: en lecha gadol bevaale teshuva yoter miyyoshiyyahu bedoro veechad bedorenu. umannu? abba avu derabbi yirmeya bar abba. veamri la acha achu deabba avu derav yirmeya bar abba. deamar mar: rabbi abba veacha ache havo.

Amar rav yosef: veod echad bedorenu. umannu? — ukevan bar nechemya resh galuta. vehayeynu "natan detzutzita". amar rav yosef: hava yatevna befirka, vahava ka menamnamna, vachazay bechelma deka peshat yedeh vekabbeleh.
Haderan alach bema behema

a: Mishna bamma ishsha yotza, uvamma enah yotza?
Lo tetze ishsha lo bechute tzemer velo bechute pishtan velo birtzuot shebberoshah. velo titbol bahen, ad shetterappem.
Velo betotefet" velo besarbitin bizman sheenan tefurim. velo bechavul lirshut harabbim.
Velo beir shel zahav velo bekatla velo binzamim velo betabbaat sheen aleha chotam velo bemachat sheenah nekuva.
Veim yatzat enah chayyevet chattat.
Gemara tevila man dechar shema?

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar rabba bar avu — ma taam kaamar: ma taam lo tetze ishsha lo bechute tzemer velo bechute pishtan — mippene sheamru chachamim bachol la titbol bahen ad shetterappem. vechevan divchol la titbol bahen ad shetterappem, beshabbat lo tetze, dilma mitreme la tevila shel mitzva vesharya lehu, veate leetoyinhu arba ammot birshut harabbim.
Bea minneh rav kahana merav: tiche chalilata may? amar leh: arig kaamrat? kol shehu arig lo gazru. ittemar name, amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: kol shehu arig lo gazru.
Veikka deamri, amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: chazena leachvoti dela kafdan alayyhu.
May ikka ben hach lishshana uven hach lishshana?
Ikka benayyhu ditnifan. lehach lishshana deamar kol shehu arig lo gazru — hane name arig ninhu, ulehach lishshana deamrat mishshum kefida — kevan ditnifa mikpad kafda alayyhu.

Tenan hatam: veellu chotztzin baadam: chute tzemer vechute pishtan vehartzuot shebberashe habbanot. rabbi yehuda omer: shel tzemer veshel sear en chotztzin mippene shehammayim bain bahen. amar rav huna: vechullan, berashe habbanot shaninu.
Matkif la rav yosef: lemaote may? illema lemaote detzavvar, udemay: illema lemaote detzemer — hasheta rach al gabbe kashe chotzetz, rach al gabbe rach mibbaya?
Veella lemaote dechute fishtan. hasheta kashe al gabbe kashe chotzetz, kashe al gabbe rach mibbaya?
Ella amar rav yosef, hayeynu tama derav huna: lefi sheen ishsha choneket et atzmah.
Etiveh abbaye: habbanot yotzot bechutin shebbeoznehen, aval lo bachavakin shebbetzavverehen. vei amrat en ishsha choneket atzmah, chavakin shebbetzavverehen ammay la?
Amar ravina:
b: Hacha bekatla askinan, deishsha choneket et atzmah — denicha la shetterae kevaalat basar.
Rabbi yehuda omer shel tzemer veshel sear en chotztzin, mippene shehammayim bain bahen.
Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda bechute sear.
Amar leh abbaye: halacha, mikkelal difligi!
Vechi tema, i lav deshameh letanna kamma deayyeyri bechute sear, ihu name la hava mayyre — vedilma "keshem" kaamar lehu: ki hechi demoditu li bechute sear, odo li name bechute tzemer.
Ittemar, amar rav nachman amar shemuel: modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bechute sear.
Tanya name hachi: chute tzemer chotztzin, chute sear en chotztzin. rabbi yehuda omer: shel tzemer veshel sear en chotztzin.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: yotza ishsha bechute sear, ben mishshella ben mishshel chavertah. manni? ilema rabbi yehuda — afillu chute tzemer name! ella lav rabbanan hi, ushema minna bechute sear la peligi. shema minna.
Lo betotefet". may "totefet"? amar rav yosef: chumarta diktifta.
Amar leh abbaye: tihve kekamea mumeche, vetishtere!
Ella amar rav yehuda mishshemeh deabbaye: afuzeyayne. tanya name hachi: yotza ishsha bisvacha hammuzehevet, uvetotefet uvesarbitin hakkevuin bah.
Ezo totefet veezo sarbitin? amar rabbi avahu: totefet — hammukkefet lah meozen leozen. sarbitin — hammaggiin lah ad lechayeha.
Amar rav huna: aniyyot osin otan shel mine tzivonin, ashirot osin otan shel kesef veshel zahav.
Velo bechavul. amar rabbi yannay: kavul ze eni yodea mahu: i kavla deavda tenan — aval kippa shel tzemer shappir dame, o dilma kippa shel tzemer tenan — vechol shekken kavla deavda.

Amar rabbi avahu: mistabbera keman deamar kippa shel tzemer tenan. vetanya name hachi: yotza ishsha bechavul uveistama lechatzer, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af bechavul lirshut harabbim. kelal amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol shehu lematta min hassevacha — yotzin bo, kol shehu lemala min hassevacha — en yotzin bo.
May "istama"? amar rabbi avahu: bizyone. may "bizyone"? amar abbaye amar rav: kalya paroche.
Tanu rabbanan, shelosha devarim neemru beistama: en bah mishshum kilayim, veenah metammea bingaim, veen yotzin bah lirshut harabbim.
Mishshum rabbi shimon amru: af

a: En bah mishshum atrot kallot.
Ushemuel amar: kavla deavda tenan. umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaamar shemuel: yotze haeved bechotam shebbetzavvaro, aval lo bechotam shebbichsuto!
La kashya: ha daavad leh rabbeh, ha daavad ihu lenafsheh.
Bemay okimta leha dishmuel — daavad leh rabbeh? bechotam shebbichsuto ammay la!

Dilma mippesak, umirtat umeykappel leh umachet leh akkatpeh. kidrav yitzchak bar yosef, deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: hayyotze betallit mekuppelet umunnachat lo al ketefav beshabbat — chayyayv chattat.
Vechi ha daamar leh shemuel lerav chinnana bar shela: kullehu rabbanan deve resh galuta la lippeku besarbale chatime, levar minnach — dela kafdi alaych deve resh galuta.
Gufa, amar shemuel: yotze haeved bechotam shebbetzavvaro aval lo bechotam shebbichsuto. tanya name hachi: yotze haeved bechotam shebbetzavvaro aval lo bechotam shebbichsuto.
Ureminhu: lo yetze haeved bechotam shebbetzavvaro velo bechotam shebbichsuto, ze vaze en mekabbelin tumea. velo bezog shebbetzavvaro, aval yotze hu bezog shebbichsuto, ze vaze mekabbelin tumea.
Velo tetze behema lo bechotam shebbetzavvarah, velo bechotam shebbichsutah, velo bezog shebbichsutah, velo bezog shebbetzavvarah, ze vaze en mekabbelin tumea!
Lema, ha daavad leh rabbeh, ha daavad ihu lenafsheh.
La, idi veidi daavad leh rabbeh — vechan beshel mattechet, vechan beshel tit, vechidrav nachman amar rabba bar avu: davar hammakpid alav rabbo — en yotzin bo. davar sheen makpid alav — yotzin bo.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane: ze vaze en mekabbelin tumea. i amrat bishlama shel mattechet — hane hu dela mekabbeli tumea, ha kelim didhu mekabbeli tumea.
Ella i amrat beshel tit tenan, hane hu dela mekabbeli tumea, ha kelim didhu mekabbeli tumea?!
Veha tanya: kele avanim kele gelalim uchele adama — en mekabbelin tumea lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim. ella shema minna shel mattechet. shema minna.
Amar mar: velo bezog shebbetzavvaro, aval yotze hu bezog shebbichsuto.
Zog shebbetzavvaro ammay la — dilma mippesik veate leetoye? zog shebbichsuto name lichush dilma mippesik veate leetoye!
Hacha vemay askinan — dimcha beh mumecha. vechidrav huna bereh derav yehoshua. deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: kol shehu arug lo gazru.
Amar mar: lo tetze behema lo bechotam shebbetzavvarah, velo bechotam shebbichsutah, velo bezog shebbetzavvarah, velo bezog shebbichsutah, ze vaze en mekabbelin tumea.
Vezog divhema en mekabbelin tumea? ureminhu: zog shel behema — temea,
b: Veshel delet — tahor.

Shel delet vaasao livhema — tame. shel behema vaasao ledelet, af al pi shechibbero laddelet ukevao bemasmerim — tame, shekkol hakkelim yordin lide tumeatan bemachshava, veen olin midde tumeatan ella beshinnuy maase!
La kashya: ha deit leh inbal, ha delet leh inbal.
Ma nafshach: i mana hu, af al pi delet leh inbal. i lav mana hu — inbal meshavve leh mana?!

In, kidrabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan. deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin lemashmia kol bichle mattachot shehu tame, shenneemar: "kol davar asher yavo vaesh taaviru vaesh" — afillu dibbur, yavo baesh.
Bemay okimta — bidlet leh inbal? ema metziata: velo bezog shebbetzavvaro, aval yotze hu bezog shebbichsuto, veze vaze mekabbelin tumea. i delet leh inbal mi mekabbeli tumea?
Ureminhu: haose zogin lemachteshet velaarisa ulemitpechot sefarim ulemitpechot tinokot, yesh lahem inbal — temein, en lahem inbal — tehorin, nittelu inbelehen — adayin tumeatan alehem.
Hane mille betinok, dilkala avdi leh. aval gadol — tachshit hu leh, af al gav delet leh inbal.
Amar mar: nittelu inbelehen adayin tumeatan alehen. lemay chazu? amar abbaye: hoil shehahedyot yachol lehachaziro.
Metiv rava: hazzug vehainbal chibbur.
Vechi tema, hachi kaamar: af al gav dela mechabbar — keman dimchabbar dame. vehatanya: masporet shel perakim veizmel shel rahitne — chibbur lattumea veen chibbur lahazzaa.
Veamrinan: ma nafshach, i chibbur hu — afillu lehazzaa, vei la chibbur hu — afillu letumea name la!

Veamar rabba: devar tora, bishat melacha — chibbur ben letumea ben lehazzaa. shello bishat melacha — eno chibbur lo letumea velo lehazzaa. vegazru al tumea shello bishat melacha mishshum tumea shehi bishat melacha, veal hazzaa shehi bishat melacha mishshum hazzaa shello bishat melacha.
Ella amar rava:
